0-1.title: 绿灯、车皮与签名

lines.zh: 调度室里的暖气片半凉不热，铁管里不时传出水垢被冲刷的敲击声。窗外的广轨编组站正被白毛风裹得严严实实，一列刷着防化绿漆的重型装甲车头正在顶推车皮，车顶两挺重机枪在雪里凝成了两个白疙瘩——那是“布拉风号”，站上的老工人都管它叫“铁壳号”。
lines.en: The radiator in the dispatch office was half-warm at best; now and then a knock travelled through the iron pipes as scale was flushed loose. Outside, the broad-gauge marshalling yard was sealed tight in the white squall. A heavy armoured locomotive painted in anti-chemical green was shunting boxcars, two heavy machine guns on its roof frozen into white lumps in the snow — the armoured train Buran, which the old hands at the station called the Iron Shell.

lines.zh: 墙上用图钉扎着本周配额进度表，蓝墨水画的折线在末端耷拉下去。红铅笔批注压在末尾：【第17区人员转运编组完成率61%：连续两周不达标，市政供暖降温40%】。
lines.en: This week's quota chart was pinned to the wall with drawing pins, its blue-ink line sagging at the end. A red-pencil annotation lay pressed beneath it: [District 17 personnel-transfer marshalling, 61% complete: second consecutive week below target; municipal heating reduced by 40%].

lines.zh: 调度长用指甲剔了剔牙缝，把一张三联复写单推到阿列克谢面前。单子旁边压着区管委后勤科的一页便签，上面盖着褪色的椭圆章：瑞士 409 批腹膜透析液，超额留用，配额一箱（6袋）。
lines.en: The dispatcher picked at his teeth with a fingernail and slid a triplicate carbon form across to Aleksei. Beside it lay a memo from the logistics section of the District Rationing Committee, stamped with a faded oval seal: Swiss Batch 409 peritoneal dialysis fluid, retained beyond quota, one case allocated (6 bags).

lines.zh: 阿列克谢的母亲卡佳在 602 室已经两天没能排出毒素，双腿肿得像泡发的面团，皮肤薄得发亮，一碰就渗黄水。
lines.en: For two days now his mother Katya, in Room 602, had been unable to purge the toxins from her body. Her legs were swollen like risen dough, the skin thin and shiny, weeping yellow fluid at a touch.

lines.zh: 内务部要一节闷罐编进布拉风号。乌拉尔山线。004 号车皮，底单在电传机里。你签个字，本周指标算咱们超额。你妈那一箱药，明早头一班吉斯卡车送进你们楼。
lines.stage: （把印泥盒推过来，铁盒盖在桌面上蹭出一道白印）
lines.en: The Ministry wants one boxcar coupled to the Buran. The Ural Line. Boxcar 004; the Dispatch Slip is in the teletype. Sign here and this week's target counts as over-fulfilled for us. That case of medicine for your mother goes into your building on the first ZIS truck tomorrow morning.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢扶了扶眼镜。左边镜腿用黑绝缘胶布缠了三圈，胶布脱胶，黏在耳根上发痒。他凑近看了看底单。
lines.en: Aleksei adjusted his glasses. The left arm had been wrapped three times with black electrical tape; the adhesive had gone tacky and it itched against the base of his ear. He leaned closer to read the Dispatch Slip.

lines.zh:
品名……疫区留观人员及陪护，一百七十六名。
……调度长，一百七十六个活人，怎么能按‘零号散货’走账？
lines.stage: （钢笔尖悬在纸上，离纸面不到半寸）
lines.en:
Description... persons under observation from the infected zone and their attendants, one hundred and seventy-six.
...Dispatcher, one hundred and seventy-six living people — how can they be booked as 'zero-grade bulk freight'?

lines.zh: 莫罗佐夫，电传机认代码，不认人。你签了，他们是一百七十六个转运编号；你不签，全楼供暖明晚掐掉两截，你妈连明天中午都熬不过去。你自己掂量。
lines.stage: （眼皮都没抬一下）
lines.en: Morozov, the teletype reads codes, not people. You sign, and they become one hundred and seventy-six transfer numbers. You don't, and two heating lines get cut off for the whole building tomorrow night — your mother won't last till noon. Weigh it yourself.

lines.zh: 门口的皮帘子被掀开，灌进一股刺骨的煤焦油味。“老轨”伊万提着防风信号灯跨进来，身上落满了硬雪碴子。老头吐掉嘴里烧尽的烟蒂，靴底在水泥地上跺得震天响。
lines.en: The leather curtain at the door was flung back and a biting smell of coal tar poured in. Old Ivan, the railman, stepped over the threshold carrying a storm lantern, hard snow crusting his coat. He spat out a burnt-down cigarette end and stamped his boots on the concrete until it thundered.

lines.zh: 小子，装人的车皮，手别太顺。第三节车厢的门框是生铁浇的，上面钉过的单子，几十年雪都冲不干净。
lines.stage: （从阿列克谢背后走过，看都没看桌上的单子）
lines.en: Son, don't get too handy with a boxcar that carries people. The doorframe of the third car is cast iron. Slips nailed up there — decades of snow haven't washed the marks clean.

lines.zh: 伊万掀帘子出去了，穿堂风把桌上的复写纸掀起一个角。
lines.en: Ivan lifted the curtain and went out; the draught turned up one corner of the carbon paper on the desk.

0-1.choices_markdown:
**【抉择 E0 · 签字时刻】**
- **E0-1（低头签字）**：阿列克谢闭了闭眼，钢笔在第三联末尾划下“阿·莫罗佐夫”。复写纸背面洇出紫黑色的笔迹。电传终端绿灯亮起，打印针咔嗒作响：`【004号车皮调拨单已受理 · 随车联发运】`。
- **E0-2（迟疑核对）**：阿列克谢核对了三个名字，直到调度长伸手去抽那张透析液批条。他一把按住批条，在单据上按下了带血手印的私章。
- **E0-3（试图划掉陪护栏）**：调度长夺过钢笔，直接在上面盖上公章：“别犯蠢，少一个数字，全车皮都走不了。”阿列克谢最终默许了公章落下。

工人提着铆钉枪走过站台。随车联被锁进一块厚黄铜夹板，四枚铆钉结结实实打进 004 号闷罐车厢的铁门框上，随后刷上了一层防冻清漆。在风雪里，黄铜铭牌上阿列克谢的签名透着冰冷的反光。

汽笛拉响，铁轨在脚底下震颤。阿列克谢把那张透析液批条塞进大衣内袋，贴着胸口。隔着粗呢子布，纸片像冰块一样硌着肋骨。

十天后。妹妹拉娜去药局给母亲换碘伏帽，在红区外围排队做第三轮刮片筛查，被划入红码。她被清杀队带走塞进的车厢，正是这节挂在铁壳号车尾的 004 号。

## 第一幕：黑洞与绿灯（适应夜潜与红区假人）

- **关卡代号**：L01 – L02
- **场景**：赫鲁晓夫筒子楼 602 室 → 单元楼梯间 → 城北四号铁路冷库（昼）→ 夜间广轨货场与外围防线（夜）
- **时间**：Z 年 11 月 17 日 – 19 日
- **登场人物**：阿列克谢、卡佳妈妈、切尔诺夫中士、谢尔盖母子、灰烬（狼犬）、年轻新兵帕沙
- **核心机制**：夜潜视线、听声辨位、探照灯Ⅰ级巡弋、三色声音波纹、良知“卌”字记账
0-1.title_en: Green Lights, Boxcars, and a Signature

lines.zh: 602 室的空气里混杂着发霉的墙皮味、消毒水味和尿毒症晚期呼出的氨水味。
lines.en: The air in Room 602 was a mixture of mildewed plaster, disinfectant, and the ammonia breath of advanced uraemia.

lines.zh: 铁架床上，卡佳妈妈盖着两床褪色的红蓝格羊毛毯，露在被子外的双手布满了青紫色的针眼。腹透机每隔四十分钟便发出一次低沉的排液抽吸声。
lines.en: On the iron bed Mama Katya lay under two faded red-and-blue checked wool blankets, the hands left outside the covers mapped with bruise-purple needle marks. Every forty minutes the dialysis machine gave a low, draining suck.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢蹲在床边，正用温水擦拭母亲浮肿发亮的小腿。
lines.en: Aleksei crouched beside the bed, wiping his mother's swollen, shiny calves with warm water.

lines.zh: ……阿廖沙……外头……风停了吗？
lines.stage: （喉咙里泛着痰音，眼睛半睁着）
lines.en: ...Alyosha... outside... has the wind stopped?

lines.zh: 还没呢，妈。今天刮大烟暴。
lines.stage: （动作放轻，拧干毛巾）
lines.en: Not yet, Mama. There's a real smoke-blizzard blowing.

lines.zh: 拉娜……拉娜怎么还没下班？那孩子……出门时只穿了薄棉鞋，脚后跟容易生冻疮……
lines.en: Lana... why isn't Lana off work yet? That child... she went out in thin padded shoes; her heels always get chilblains...

lines.zh: 阿列克谢的手停了一下，毛巾上的温水滴在铁盆里，溅出轻微的脆响。他从大衣内袋摸出那张皱巴巴的假便条——那是他前天夜里模仿妹妹字迹写的：“医院封控两周，在宿舍住，勿念。拉娜。”
lines.en: Aleksei's hand faltered; warm water dripped from the cloth into the iron basin with a faint, brittle sound. From his inner coat pocket he drew the crumpled forged note — he had copied his sister's hand two nights before: 'Hospital locked down for two weeks. Staying in the dormitory. Don't worry. Lana.

lines.zh: 铁路医院派她去外地支援医疗了，最近电报也不通。她托人送了信，让您按时用药，等支援结束就回来。
lines.en: The railway hospital sent her away on a medical support detail. The telegraph lines are down just now. She got a letter sent: take your medicine on time, she'll be back when the detail ends.

lines.zh: 卡佳妈妈闭上眼睛，眼眶陷在黑眼圈里。她摸索着抓住儿子的手腕，粗糙的掌心摩挲着阿列克谢手背上的防伪留观蓝印油。
lines.en: Mama Katya closed her eyes, the sockets sunk in rings of black. She groped for her son's wrist, her rough palm worrying the blue anti-forgery observation stamp on the back of Aleksei's hand.

lines.zh: 阿廖沙……你手背上的蓝印子，洗不掉吧？……隔壁瓦莲京娜说，手上盖了这个章的人，夜里走路都不能挺胸……
lines.en: Alyosha... that blue mark on your hand, it won't wash off, will it? ...Valentina next door says a person stamped like that can't walk at night with his chest held up...

lines.zh:
墙角那个用铁皮外壳包着的寻呼终端突然剧烈蜂鸣起来。午夜 24:00 整，终端上那颗绿色的信号灯骤然亮起，伴随着打字机般干涩的走纸声：
【第3工人居住区：今日生活必需品及药品配额已全部签收 · 签发人：核算主任 杜布罗夫】
lines.en: In the corner, the pager terminal sheathed in sheet metal burst into a shrill buzz. At precisely midnight 24:00 its green lamp snapped on, accompanied by the dry, typewriter-like feeding of paper: [Workers' Residential Block 3: today's quotas of necessities and medicine all signed for · Issuing officer: Chief Accountant Dubrov].

lines.zh: 整栋楼的管道里，原本微弱的蒸汽哨声噗地断了。为了在系统里换取“全楼保暖评级达标”，核算站强行把所有未送达的配额勾选为“已签收”。
lines.en: In the pipes throughout the building the faint steam whistle gave a puff and stopped. To earn the system's 'whole-building heating rating: compliant,' the accounting office had ticked every undelivered quota as 'signed for.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢站起身，走到厨房窗前。窗缝用旧报纸和胶水糊了三层，依然被风吹得呜呜直响。外面白茫茫一片，两道刺眼的黄白探照灯光柱在远处的铁轨上慢慢交叉切过。
lines.en: Aleksei got up and went to the kitchen window. The cracks had been pasted over with three layers of old newspaper and glue, yet the wind still moaned through. Outside, everything was white and empty; two glaring yellow-white searchlight beams crossed slowly over the distant rails.

lines.zh: 他回到门厅，套上那件褪色的铁路厚棉大衣，用麻绳把裤脚扎紧，弯腰从床底下拖出一柄铸铁道钉撬棍。那是旧机车厂的产品，拿在手里沉甸甸的，撬尖磨得雪亮。
lines.en: Back in the entry hall, he pulled on the faded heavy railway greatcoat, tied his trouser cuffs tight with hemp cord, and bent to drag a cast-iron spike crowbar out from under the bed. It was a product of the old locomotive works, heavy in the hand, its prying tip worn snow-bright.

1-2.title: 冷库里的账面死人

lines.zh: 白昼。城北四号铁路冷库。
lines.en: Daylight. Rail Cold Storage No.4, north of the city.

lines.zh: 挂满白霜的氨气管道在头顶纵横交错，地面结了一层油污与冰渣混合的黑硬壳。阿列克谢作为征召搬运工，正将一箱箱贴着内务部封条的黄油和咸鱼搬上平板手推车。
lines.en: Ammonia pipes crisscrossed overhead, thick with white frost; underfoot the floor was crusted with a black hard shell of oil and ice. Aleksei, a conscripted porter, was loading crates of butter and salt fish, sealed with Ministry of Internal Affairs strips, onto a flat handcart.

lines.zh: 在南库 3 号水泥柱后面，一个穿着破烂黑棉袄的男人正跪在冰水沟旁，怀里紧紧裹着一个裹在旧军毯里的小孩。小孩的脸色发灰，嘴唇冻得发紫。
lines.en: Behind concrete column 3 in the south hall, a man in a ragged black padded coat knelt beside a gutter of ice water, holding a child tightly wrapped in an old army blanket. The child's face was grey, its lips blue-purple with cold.

lines.zh: 内务部巡逻队的皮靴声在铁格栅通道上停下。切尔诺夫中士停在柱子前，手里拿着便携手持打卡机，金属探头对准了男人的手背。
lines.en: The boots of a Ministry patrol stopped on the iron-grate walkway. Sergeant Chernov halted before the column, a portable punch-clock in his hand, its metal probe aimed at the man's hand.

lines.zh: 终端滴地响了一声，红灯闪烁。
lines.en: The terminal gave a single beep; a red light blinked.

lines.zh: 档案 0892，谢尔盖。昨日 22:00 移交单乌拉尔山线。主脑记录：已出清。当前坐标在册人数：0。
lines.stage: （语气平直，不带情绪）
lines.en: File 0892, Sergey. Transferred to the Ural Line Station yesterday at 22:00. Central record: cleared. Persons registered at this coordinate: zero.

lines.zh: 男人猛地抬起头，眼睛里全是红血丝，干裂的嘴唇裂开血口子。
lines.en: The man's head snapped up, his eyes threaded with red, his cracked lips split and bleeding.

lines.zh: 长官……机器搞错了！我没上车，我昨天在锅炉房换班，孩子发高烧……我没死，你看，玛丽亚也没死，她还喘气呢！
lines.en: Officer... the machine's wrong! I never boarded — I was covering a shift at the boiler house yesterday, the child had a fever... I'm not dead, look, Maria's not dead either, she's still breathing!

lines.zh: 上面写着零。机器只认打孔卡。在册是零，这根柱子底下就没有人。没有人，就没有今天的配给。
lines.stage: （把终端翻转过来，屏幕对着男人的脸）
lines.en: It says zero up there. The machine reads punch cards. Zero on the register means nobody under this column. Nobody means no ration today.

lines.zh: 切尔诺夫伸手推开配给箱的铁盖，锁栓卡嗒一声落进锁槽。男人扑上去抓住中士的裤脚，指甲在硬皮靴上划出刺耳的声响。
lines.en: Chernov reached over and pushed the iron lid of the ration crate shut; the bolt clicked into its slot. The man lunged and clutched the sergeant's trouser leg, his nails scraping a shrill sound across the stiff leather boot.

lines.zh: 长官！一口，就给玛丽亚一口热汤……
lines.en: Officer! One mouthful — just one spoon of hot soup for Maria...

lines.zh: 切尔诺夫中士往后撤了半步。他没有拔枪，也没有踹人，只是机械地把男人的手指一根根掰开。在转身离开的瞬间，切尔诺夫的脚尖在雪地里微微一滞，踢开了一个碍事的空铁皮盒，低声自言自语般吐出半句话：
lines.en: Sergeant Chernov stepped back half a pace. He did not draw his pistol or kick; he only pried the man's fingers loose, one by one, mechanically. As he turned to go, his toe faltered a moment in the snow, kicked aside an empty tin box in the way, and he let fall half a sentence, almost to himself:

lines.zh: ……别在这儿耗着。去西站水塔后头找捡煤渣的，兴许有烂土豆。死在冷库里，连拉尸车都不会来。
lines.en: ...Don't waste time here. Go behind the water tower at West Station, find the cinder-pickers; there might be rotten potatoes. Die in the cold store and not even the corpse cart will come.

lines.zh: 中士带着两名队员快步走远。
lines.en: The sergeant strode off with his two men.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢站在三米外，手里的板车把手被他捏得咯咯作响。在水泥柱后的阴影里，一只缺了半只耳朵的灰狼犬正趴在废弃收发亭的台阶下。它脖颈上缠着被剪断的锈铁丝；铁丝曾经勒进皮肉，留下了一圈褪不掉的伤痕，周围的毛也长得稀疏。它没有靠近谢尔盖，只安静地看着阿列克谢。
lines.en: Aleksei stood three metres away, the handcart's grip creaking under his fingers. In the shadow behind the concrete column, a grey wolfdog with half an ear missing lay on the steps of the abandoned dispatch hut. A length of cut, rusted wire was twisted round its neck; it had once bitten into the flesh and left a ring of scar that would not fade, the fur around it grown thin. It did not go to Sergey, only watched Aleksei quietly.

1-2.choices_markdown:
**【抉择 · 冷库的留痕】**
- **coldstore-01（救人并喂灰犬）**：阿列克谢背过身，用冻裂的食指掏出钢笔，在工作日志背面写下：*“谢尔盖，玛丽亚。活人。”* 他先把半块黑麦饼递给谢尔盖，让玛丽亚吃下几口；剩下的掰成小块，放在灰犬鼻尖前。灰犬迟疑片刻，叼走了面包。阿列克谢蹲下剪断它颈上的锈铁丝，伤痕完整地露出来。他没有把狗拽走，只把手掌摊开，等它自己跟上。灰烬站起身，抖掉背上的雪，从此跟在阿列克谢身后。**灰烬仅在此选择后入队。**
- **coldstore-02（低头推车）**：阿列克谢把头埋得更低，推着重车从他们身边走过。他没有救下谢尔盖父女，也没有喂那只灰犬。灰犬留在废弃收发亭旁，颈上的断铁丝仍勒着旧伤；之后不会跟随阿列克谢。
1-2.title_en: The Paper Dead in the Cold Storage

1-3.title: 初入红区与退烧的母亲

lines.zh: 夜间 01:30。宵禁警报准时在全城回荡。
lines.en: 01:30 at night. The curfew siren sounded on schedule, echoing through the whole city.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢用撬棍顶开 602 楼下一楼锅炉房的生锈通风铁窗，冰冷的夜风瞬间灌满了他的领口。灰烬率先钻出狭窄的窗缝，落入两米深的积雪中，警惕地伏在雪坑里。
lines.en: Aleksei used the crowbar to force the rusted ventilation window of the boiler room on the ground floor below Block 602; the freezing night wind poured straight into his collar. Ash was first through the narrow gap, dropping into the two metres of accumulated snow and flattening warily into a hollow.

lines.zh: 远处铁轨上传来沉重的钢轨挤压声。高耸的水泥煤水塔顶上，Ⅰ级探照灯的黄白光柱正以极慢的节奏扫过铁丝网外围。
lines.en: Far off, the heavy grinding of rails being stressed came over the tracks. From the top of the tall concrete coal-and-water tower, the yellow-white beam of a Class-I searchlight swept the barbed-wire perimeter at a very slow rhythm.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢紧贴着废弃车厢的生锈侧板前行。前方的铁丝网破口处，忽然传来低沉的呜咽声。
lines.en: Aleksei moved along hugging the rusted flank of an abandoned freight car. At a tear in the wire fence ahead, a low moaning suddenly came.

lines.zh: 借着雪地的反光，阿列克谢看见一个穿着灰色化纤大衣的女人。她的右手背上长满了粗糙的灰白角质硬鳞，左眼的眼白被浑浊的紫黑血翳覆盖——但那片血翳正在以肉眼可见的速度剥落，露出底下深褐色的眼珠。她没有攻击周围的死物，而是死死抓着单元防盗门的铁栅栏，指节被冻得发青。
lines.en: In the reflected glare of the snow Aleksei saw a woman in a grey synthetic coat. The back of her right hand was grown over with coarse grey-white horny scales; the white of her left eye was veiled in a turbid purple-black film — but the film was flaking away at a speed the eye could follow, exposing the dark brown eyeball beneath. She was not attacking the dead things around her; she clutched the iron bars of the stairwell's security door, her knuckles blue with cold.

lines.zh: ……开门啊……科利亚，妈妈退烧了……妈妈不烫了，手背上的鳞掉在雪里了……让我看一眼小安东……
lines.stage: （声音沙哑，带着干咳）
lines.en: ...Open the door... Kolya, Mummy's fever has broken... I'm not hot any more, the scales on my hand have fallen into the snow... let me see little Anton...

lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声踩碎积雪。两道雪亮的光柱猛地将女人罩在中央。
lines.en: Heavy boots crushed the snow. Two glaring beams caught the woman squarely in their centre.

lines.zh: 两名身穿铅灰色厚橡胶防化服的清杀队员从涵洞拐角步出，圆形的猪嘴防毒面具在强光下反射出无机质的冰冷光泽。他们手里的 AKM 步枪下挂红外线瞄准器，红点直接落在了女人的胸口。
lines.en: Two OSK men in lead-grey heavy rubber protective suits came round the culvert, their round pig-snout gas masks throwing off an inorganic, cold sheen in the glare. Infrared sights were mounted under the AKM rifles in their hands; the red dot settled directly on the woman's chest.

lines.zh: 女人惊恐地抬起手遮挡强光，嘴里还在徒劳地辩解：“我好了……真的好了，我不咬人……”
lines.en: The woman flung up a hand against the light, still protesting in vain: 'I'm better... really better, I don't bite...

lines.zh:
噗。噗。
微声枪口冒出两团极短的蓝焰。
lines.en:
Pfft. Pfft.
Two very short blue flames spat from the suppressed muzzles.

lines.zh: 女人应声倒下，身体在雪地里抽搐了两下便不再动弹。黑红色的血渗进雪层，迅速冻成硬邦邦的黑冰。其中一名队员面无表情地上前，用靴尖将女人抓在手里的那串家用铜钥匙踢进水沟，按动挂在胸前的电传终端：【红区外围发现异化目标一名，已按规程出清。】
lines.en: The woman fell at the sound, convulsed twice in the snow, then lay still. Black-red blood soaked into the snow and froze quickly into hard black ice. One of the men, face void of expression, stepped up and kicked the bunch of household copper keys from her hand into the gutter, then worked the teletype terminal at his chest: [One Rabid sighted on the edge of the Red Zone; cleared according to protocol].

lines.zh: 阿列克谢死死捂住灰烬的吻部，整个人陷在煤堆的阴影里，心脏在胸膛里疯狂撞击。
lines.en: Aleksei clamped a hand hard over Ash's muzzle, sinking whole into the shadow of the coal heap, his heart hammering against his chest.

lines.zh: 女人手背上的鳞屑在融雪中一片片脱落。
lines.en: The scales on the back of the woman's hand flaked off one by one into the melting snow.

lines.zh: 她没有疯。她退烧了。
lines.en: She was not mad. Her fever had broken.

lines.zh: 熬过高热的人会好起来。
lines.en: Those who survive the high fever get better.

lines.zh: 那被装进铁壳号第三节车厢的拉娜……也可能正处在退烧的过程中。
lines.en: And Lana, shut into the Buran's third boxcar... might be in the middle of her fever breaking too.

1-3.title_en: First Entry into the Red Zone, and a Mother's Fever Breaking

1-4.title: 假人哨塔与新兵帕沙

lines.zh: 越过第二道铁轨阻拦索，前方出现了一座三米高的木架哨塔。
lines.en: Past the second rail cable barrier, a three-metre wooden watchtower rose ahead.

lines.zh: 哨塔上伫立着一名端枪的清杀队员，在探照灯的背光下显得异常高大威严。然而灰烬甚至没有压低身子，只是慢吞吞地从塔下走过。
lines.en: On the tower stood an OSK guard with a rifle at the ready, looming unnaturally tall and solemn against the searchlight. Ash did not even lower its body; it merely ambled past beneath.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢贴近铁梯。头顶上传来断续的录音机杂音，一台挂在木栏杆上的开盘机正转动着磁带，用失真的大喇叭嗓音反复播报着《告居民书》。
lines.en: Aleksei pressed close to the iron ladder. Overhead came the broken crackle of a tape recorder; a reel-to-reel set hung on the wooden rail, its tape turning, repeating a distorted loudspeaker voice reading the 'Notice to Residents'.

lines.zh: 塔上的“哨兵”是用三根杉木条和旧防化服扎起来的假人，空荡荡的风镜里塞着碎棉花。
lines.en: The 'sentry' on the tower was a dummy lashed together from three fir planks and an old protective suit, bits of cotton wadding stuffed into the empty goggles.

lines.zh: 而在铁梯底下的避风背阴处，蜷缩着一个真正的人。
lines.en: But at the foot of the ladder, in the windless shade, a real person lay curled up.

lines.zh: 那是个年轻得有些过分的士兵，防化服套在他身上显得过于宽大，下摆拖在雪地里。他把防毒面具摘了下来扔在脚边，露出一张被高烧烧得干红的脸，嘴唇起了一层白皮。他手里握着一支玻璃水银体温计，借着雪光反复看着刻度：39.2℃。
lines.en: He was a soldier ridiculously young, the protective suit far too big for him, its hem trailing in the snow. He had pulled off his gas mask and tossed it by his feet, showing a face flushed dry-red with fever, a white film peeling on his lips. In his hand he held a glass mercury thermometer, and by the light of the snow he read the scale again and again: 39.2°C.

lines.zh: 听见雪地的碎响，士兵吓得一哆嗦，下意识地去抓地上的步枪，但手抖得连枪带都没握住。
lines.en: Hearing the crunch of snow, the soldier flinched and reached instinctively for the rifle on the ground, but his hands shook so badly he could not even catch the sling.

lines.zh: ……别……别过来！我手里有家伙……
lines.stage: （带着浓重的农村口音，吸着鼻涕）
lines.en: ...Don't... don't come closer! I've got a gun here...

lines.zh: 阿列克谢停在三步外，手里的撬棍微微下垂。
lines.en: Aleksei stopped three paces away, the crowbar dipping slightly in his hand.

lines.zh: 你的枪栓都没拉开。
lines.en: You haven't even racked the bolt.

lines.zh: 帕沙愣了一下，低头看了看枪，眼泪突然涌了出来。他吸了吸鼻子，用冻裂的袖口去擦脸。
lines.en: Pasha stared, looked down at the rifle, and the tears came suddenly. He sniffed and wiped his face with a cracked, frozen cuff.

lines.zh: 哥……我求你了，你有退烧药吗？阿司匹林、安乃近，什么都行……我体温到了三十九度二。明天清早督察队要用红外枪量额头，要是过了三十八度五，假人哨塔顶上挂的就该是我了……
lines.en: Brother... please, do you have anything to bring a fever down? Aspirin, analgin, anything... my temperature's 39.2. At dawn the inspectors will measure foreheads with an infrared gun; if it's over 38.5, I'm the one they'll hang on top of that dummy tower...

lines.zh: 你是内务部的人。你们车队里连阿司匹林都没有？
lines.stage: （盯着他身上那件铅灰色的正规军大衣）
lines.en: You're with the Ministry. Your whole convoy hasn't got a single aspirin?

lines.zh: 哪有我们的份啊……那是特勤连的官老爷才有的。我们这种从奥廖尔招来的新兵，发一身大衣服就往铁道上一扔……以前在村里，天旱了怕颗粒无收，涝了怕塌房。穿上这身皮，站在那儿跟木头人一样，队里就管饭，没人问你家里还有几口人。阿廖沙……我听他们这么叫你。当木头人多省心啊，站在塔上一动不动，没人扣你的工分，也没人查你体温……可我一发烧，我就怕……我想我娘腌的酸黄瓜……
lines.stage: （蹲在地上，抱住膝盖发抖）
lines.en: Not for the likes of us... that's for the gentlemen in the special details. New conscripts like me, dragged in from Oryol — they hand you a big coat and drop you by the railway... Back in the village, in a drought you feared the harvest would fail; in flood you feared the roof would fall. In this skin, you stand there like a wooden man and the unit feeds you; nobody asks how many are left at home. Alyosha... that's what I heard them call you. It's easy being a wooden man — stand on the tower without moving, nobody docks your work points, nobody checks your temperature... but once I start burning, I get scared... I want my mother's pickled cucumbers...

1-4.choices_markdown:
**【抉择 A′ · 帕沙的 39 度 2】**
- **A′1（给出退烧片）**：阿列克谢在怀里摸索了很久，掏出一个小纸包，里面是他在黑市花两袋面粉换来的三片退烧药。他倒出一片，递给帕沙。帕沙像接圣餐一样把药片吞了下去，连雪水都没来得及嚼。少年感激地从防化服内侧摸出一枚崭新的未拆封滤毒罐塞给阿列克谢：“哥，这个给你！巡逻队查得严，红区起烟的时候，这个能顶四十分钟……明天要是我的哨，我把探照灯往天顶上打。”（**良知▲**，获得道具【帕沙的滤毒罐】；后续红区潜行警觉度积累速度减半；终局崖顶帕沙枪口抬高一寸）。
- **A′2（绕开不理）**：阿列克谢看了看他，一言不发地退回阴影中。十分钟后，身后传来换岗巡逻队的脚步声，接着是一声沉闷的微声枪响。木头人多了一个，省心的人少了一个。
- **A′3（夺取补给）**：阿列克谢用撬棍顶住少年的喉咙，扒下了他身上的备用滤毒罐和口袋里仅剩的半条压缩饼干。少年绝望地瘫在雪里。工作日志背面，阿列克谢用钢笔划下了第一道深重的竖痕：“|”。
1-4.title_en: The Dummy Watchtower and the Rookie Pasha

1-4A.title: 货场黑账与扎哈尔

lines.zh: 货场换岗时，阿列克谢从煤水塔后绕过一排待报废的配给箱。一个戴蓝袖章的核算员正把没收来的手套、滤芯和烟草重新分堆，手里那本账簿没有一页写着失主的名字。
lines.en: During the shift change at the freight yard, Aleksei slips around the coal-water tower past a row of ration crates marked for scrap. A blue-armband clerk is re-sorting confiscated gloves, filter cartridges, and tobacco; not one page of the ledger in his hand bears the name of a rightful owner.

lines.zh: 我叫扎哈尔。死人身上多一件，账上就多一件；商人和半人身上也一样。带我走，我知道怎么把东西翻出来。别把这当忠诚，我只跟着能让我多领一份配额的人。
lines.stage: （把账本合上，先看了看阿列克谢的手，再看向远处的巡逻灯）
lines.en: My name is Zakhar. One more item off a dead man, one more line in the ledger — same with traders and Half-Humans. Take me with you. I know how to make things surface. Don't take this for loyalty; I only follow the man who lets me draw an extra ration.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢问他，如果清杀队愿意拿配额换一份举报，他会怎么做。扎哈尔没有否认，只用拇指擦掉账本封面上的冻泥。
lines.en: Aleksei asked him what he would do if the OSK offered rations in exchange for a denunciation. Zakhar did not deny it; he only wiped the frozen mud from the ledger's cover with his thumb.

lines.zh: 要是他们给的配额比你给的多，我会把知道的都报上去。账不会替谁讲情。
lines.en: If they offer more rations than you do, I'll report everything I know. A ledger doesn't plead for anyone.

lines.zh: 扎哈尔跟随阿列克谢离开货场。此后若阿列克谢多次选择杀戮、出卖同伴或掠夺无抵抗者，扎哈尔会把阿列克谢的行踪交给清杀队，换取冬季配额；这不是突发反转，而是他在入队时已经说清的交易方式。
lines.en: Zakhar leaves the freight yard with Aleksei. If Aleksei repeatedly kills, betrays his companions, or preys on those who cannot resist, Zakhar will hand his movements over to the OSK in exchange for winter rations — not a sudden reversal, but the very terms he made clear when he joined.

lines.zh:
- 关卡代号：L03 – L05
- 场景：白桦林公寓四点整死窗 → 601 室门外楼道 → 东街工人食堂后厨 → 旧传染病疗养院地下室
- 时间：Z 年 11 月 20 日 – 28 日
- 登场人物：阿列克谢、莉莉娅（402 室）、柳德米拉大娘、外孙女佳娜、炊事员费奥多尔老爹、瓦西里、古丽娅医师、梁诺夫医生
- 核心机制：限时卡门阻击、创伤后遗症（干渴耳鸣）、自愈手稿真伪查证
lines.en:
- Level code: L03 – L05
- Scenes: Birch Grove Apartments' four-o'clock sealed hatch → corridor outside Room 601 → East Street Workers' Canteen kitchen → old infectious-disease sanatorium basement
- Time: Year Z, November 20 – 28
- Cast: Aleksei, Lilia (Room 402), Grandmother Lyudmila, granddaughter Dyana, old cook Fyodor, Vasily, Dr. Gulya, Dr. Leonov
- Core mechanics: timed door-blocking defence, PTSD (thirst, tinnitus), verifying the authenticity of the Regression Manuscript

1-4A.title_en: The Freight Yard's Black Ledger and Zakhar

2-1.title: 白桦林公寓东窗与 601 室的算计

lines.zh: 白桦林公寓原本是一栋纺织女工宿舍，如今整栋楼被四米高的铁丝网和铁皮封板包裹得像一只铁皮棺材。一楼的所有门窗全被厚钢板封死，只在东侧留了一个半米见方的铁抽屉窗口，用于每日下午四点前进行物资交接。
lines.en: Birch Grove Apartments was once a dormitory for female textile workers; now the whole building is wrapped in four-metre wire mesh and sheet-metal panels like a tin coffin. Every door and window on the ground floor is sealed shut with thick steel plate, save for a half-metre-square iron drawer-hatch on the east side, used for the daily handover of supplies before four o'clock each afternoon.

lines.zh: 15:52。阿列克谢抱着一个用粗布包裹的铁皮奶粉罐冲过铁轨下穿涵洞。那是他在西区旧仓库翻出的深度水解抗敏奶粉，罐身生了锈，但密封完好。
lines.en: 15:52. Aleksei sprints through the railway underpass, clutching a tin of formula wrapped in coarse cloth. He found it in an old West District warehouse — extensively hydrolyzed hypoallergenic formula, the tin rusted but the seal intact.

lines.zh: 东侧交接窗口前，负责消毒的蓝袖章核算员正拿着一把长嘴喷壶，对着铁抽屉喷洒浓烈的来苏尔药水。
lines.en: At the east handover hatch, the blue-armband clerk in charge of disinfection is spraying the iron drawer with a long-spouted can of strong Lysol solution.

lines.zh: 系统词条里只有标准 1 号全脂奶粉，你这个是私货，没有检疫铅封。按规程，就地销毁。
lines.en: The system registry lists only Standard No. 1 whole-milk formula. What you have is private stock, with no quarantine seal. By regulation, it must be destroyed on the spot.

lines.zh: 402 的孩子吃全脂奶粉喉咙水肿快憋死了！你睁开眼看看，这是药房的封条！
lines.stage: （一把按住下坠的铁闸门）
lines.en: The child in Room 402 is choking — his throat is swelling from whole-milk formula! Open your eyes and look: this is a pharmacy seal!

lines.zh: 我只看终端。四点整主脑断网平账，多一件无码物品，整栋楼扣除两分信用值。
lines.en: I only read the terminal. At four the Central Mainframe goes offline to balance the books; one unmarked item too many costs the whole building two credit points.

lines.zh: 15:59。电动铁闸发出低沉的下压齿轮咬合声。阿列克谢额头青筋暴起，直接将手里的道钉撬棍横着卡进了齿轮槽！火花四溅中，钢铁挤压出令人牙酸的摩擦声。他猛地拉开抽屉，将奶粉罐顺着滑道狠狠推了进去！
lines.en: 15:59. The electric shutter grinds down with a low meshing of gears. The veins bulge on Aleksei's forehead as he jams his railway-spike crowbar sideways into the gear track. Sparks fly; steel grinds against steel with a sound that sets the teeth on edge. He wrenches the drawer open and shoves the tin hard down the chute.

lines.zh: 铁窗内侧，一只布满冻疮的年轻女人的手一把抱住了奶粉罐，窗缝里传来 402 室莉莉娅带着哭腔的抽泣：“……谢谢……谢谢……”
lines.en: Inside the iron hatch, a young woman's hand, covered in chilblains, closes around the tin. Through the gap comes the sobbing voice of Lilia in Room 402: “...Thank you... thank you...”

lines.zh: 然而，当阿列克谢拔出撬棍跌坐在雪地里时，他抬起头，看见对面三楼、四楼好几个被霜花封住的玻璃窗后面，有几双眼睛正冷冷地盯着他。一台老式胶卷相机的镜头在窗帘缝隙里闪了一下。
lines.en: Yet when Aleksei pulls the crowbar free and drops into the snow, he looks up and sees, behind several frost-sealed windows on the third and fourth floors across the way, pairs of eyes fixed coldly upon him. The lens of an old film camera glints in a gap in the curtains.

lines.zh: 当夜。601 室门外。
lines.en: That night. Outside Room 601.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢顺着楼梯间上楼时，看见 601 室的房门开了一条缝。
lines.en: As Aleksei climbs the stairwell, he sees the door of Room 601 standing ajar.

lines.zh: 六十三岁的柳德米拉大娘正坐在门口的小马扎上，借着楼道里昏暗的应急灯，手里反复数着两张红色的硬纸片。那是区管委新推行的“加配领粮券”，每张券可以换半斤黑麦粉。纸片边缘沾着几滴已经干涸的红漆。
lines.en: Sixty-three-year-old Grandmother Lyudmila sits on a small folding stool by the door, counting the same two red cardboard slips over and over in the dim emergency light. They are the District Rationing Committee's new “supplemental ration coupons,” each worth half a jin of rye flour. Dried drops of red paint cling to their edges.

lines.zh: 五岁的外孙女佳娜趴在大娘膝盖上，穿着一件极不合身的旧棉袍，正吸吮着一根发黑的空木勺。
lines.en: Her five-year-old granddaughter Dyana lies across her knees in a badly ill-fitting old padded coat, sucking on a blackened empty wooden spoon.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢在楼梯缓台上停住脚。他认出了那张券——今天下午举报 402 室私收走私货的举报箱里，就插着这种信封。
lines.en: Aleksei stops on the landing. He recognizes the coupons — the denunciation box this afternoon, for the smuggled goods taken in by Room 402, held envelopes just like these.

lines.zh: 柳德米拉大娘听见了脚步声，手一抖，两张券落在了地上。她看清了是阿列克谢，眼神先是一慌，随即迅速板了起来，像一层冻硬了的水泥。
lines.en: Lyudmila hears his footsteps; her hand jerks, and the two slips fall to the floor. When she makes out Aleksei, her expression falters for an instant, then hardens — like a layer of frozen cement.

lines.zh: 看什么看？阿廖沙，你别用那种眼神看我。我没偷没抢。
lines.stage: （把地上的券捡起来，用袖子蹭干净上面的灰）
lines.en: What are you staring at? Don't look at me like that, Alyosha. I haven't stolen anything, I haven't robbed anyone.

lines.zh: 402 楼道门刚才被人泼了红漆，莉莉娅连水房都出不去了。
lines.stage: （扶了扶眼镜，声音低沉）
lines.en: Someone threw red paint over the door to Room 402 just now. Lilia can't even get out to the washroom.

lines.zh: 那人昨天还帮我修过门轴，今天就被拖进冷库了！可我不写那张条子，佳娜拿什么冲奶？你们谁管过她哭？你妈在六楼好歹有透析液挂着，我外孙女两天没屙出一粒屎，肚子里全咽的是被面上的棉花絮！那两罐洋奶粉是她该得的吗？大家都在喝发霉的黑麦糊，凭什么她家孩子能吃洋粉？我给管委写条子，我换了两斤黑麦面，佳娜今晚能喝上一口稠的……我错哪儿了？你说啊，我错哪儿了？！
lines.stage: （声音猛地拔高，随即又心虚地压低，喉咙里发出粗重的倒气声）
lines.en: That man fixed my door hinge only yesterday, and today they dragged him off to cold storage! But if I don't write that note, what will Dyana use to mix her milk? Which of you ever cared when she cried? Your mother at least has dialysis fluid running on the sixth floor; my granddaughter hasn't passed a thing in two days — all that's in her belly is cotton wadding off the quilt! Those two tins of foreign formula — did she deserve them? Everyone's drinking mouldy rye gruel; why should that family's child get foreign powder? I wrote the Committee a note, I got two jin of rye flour, and tonight Dyana can have one thick mouthful... Where did I go wrong? Tell me — where did I go wrong?!

lines.zh: 佳娜被姥姥的喊声吓着了，把小脸埋进大娘怀里，小声嘟囔：“姥姥，不吵……佳娜不饿了……”
lines.en: Frightened by Granny's shouting, Dyana buries her little face in her grandmother's bosom and mutters softly: “Granny, don't fight... Dyana isn't hungry anymore...”

lines.zh: 柳德米拉紧紧搂住孩子，眼泪顺着满是褶子的脸颊淌进嘴角的苦纹里。她没有再说一句话，只是砰地一声把防盗门摔上，铁栓咔哒一声反锁了。
lines.en: Lyudmila holds the child tight, tears running down her lined cheeks into the bitter creases about her mouth. She says not another word; she only slams the security door shut with a bang, and the iron bolt clicks locked.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢站在昏暗的楼道里，楼下穿堂风从破损的玻璃缝里吹进来，吹得地上一张废弃的公文纸在水泥地上沙沙作响。
lines.en: Aleksei stands in the dim corridor. From below, a draught pushes through the broken glass and sets a discarded official paper rustling across the concrete floor.

2-1.title_en: The East Hatch at Birch Grove and the Scheme in Room 601

2-2.title: 后厨的砍骨刀与瓦西里的“渴”

lines.zh: 东街工人食堂。
lines.en: East Street Workers' Canteen.

lines.zh: 这里早在一个月前就停止了集中供应，整栋建筑被列入“账面清空区”。但阿列克谢知道，独眼老炊事员费奥多尔依然躲在后厨，守着地窖里仅剩的三袋陈化黑麦粒，偷偷给附近滞留的十九个老铁路工熬糊糊。
lines.en: Centralized food distribution here stopped a full month ago; the whole building was marked a “ledger-cleared zone.” But Aleksei knows the one-eyed old cook Fyodor is still hiding in the kitchen, guarding the last three sacks of aged rye in the cellar and quietly boiling gruel for the nineteen old railway workers stranded nearby.

lines.zh: 后厨弥漫着酸败的油脂味和发馊的面粉气味。地面积着寸许厚的黑水，水面上浮着薄冰。
lines.en: The kitchen reeks of rancid fat and sour flour. An inch of black water lies on the floor, with a skin of thin ice floating on it.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢挑开破烂的布帘跨进后厨。灶台边，费奥多尔老爹正蹲在地上用小煤炉煮雪水，独眼上的黑皮罩磨得发亮。
lines.en: Aleksei pushes aside the ragged cloth curtain and steps into the kitchen. By the stove, old Fyodor crouches on the floor, boiling snow water over a small coal brazier, the black leather patch over his one eye worn shiny.

lines.zh: 阿廖沙……你来得不巧。锅里只有雪水。地窖快见底了。
lines.stage: （抬头看了看阿列克谢）
lines.en: Alyosha... you've come at a bad time. There's only snow water in the pot. The cellar's nearly empty.

lines.zh: 话音未落，储藏室那扇用粗铁丝捆着的木门突然发出了一声沉重的闷响。
lines.en: Before the words are out, the storeroom door — a plank bound with coarse iron wire — gives a heavy, muffled thud.

lines.zh: 嘭！
lines.en: Bang!

lines.zh: 整扇木门被一股巨大的力量撞得向外凸起，木屑崩落。费奥多尔手里的铁勺当啷一声掉进水盆里，脸色刷地惨白。
lines.en: The whole door bows outward under some tremendous force, splinters flying. The iron ladle clatters out of Fyodor's hand into the washbasin, and his face goes white in an instant.

lines.zh: 瓦西里……是我儿子！他前天夜里冒着大雪去给四楼瘫痪的老钳工送糊糊，半路上冻透了，回来就发起高烧……我把他锁在里头，给他灌了姜水，可他……他手上的皮全硬了……
lines.stage: （声音剧烈发抖）
lines.en: Vasily... he's my son! The night before last he went out in the blizzard to take gruel to the paralysed old fitter on the fourth floor, and was frozen through before he got back — then the fever took him... I locked him in and gave him ginger water, but his... the skin on his hands has all gone hard...

lines.zh: 木门在第二下撞击中彻底炸裂开来！
lines.en: The door bursts completely apart on the second impact!

lines.zh: 一个二十出头的小伙子从黑暗中跌撞着冲了出来。他浑身滚烫，呼出的白气带着刺鼻的酸臭味，右手背到小臂覆盖着一层厚厚的灰白角质硬鳞。他的双眼布满紫黑色的血翳，喉咙里发出类似风箱漏气般的急促喘息，毫无目标地挥舞着双手，一头撞翻了备餐的铁案台！
lines.en: A young man, barely twenty, staggers out of the darkness. He is burning hot; the white breath from his mouth carries a sharp, sour stench. His right hand and forearm are covered in a thick layer of grey-white keratinous scale. Purple-black clouds fill his eyes, and a rapid, bellows-leaking rasp works in his throat. He flails blindly and crashes headlong into the steel prep table, upsetting it.

lines.zh: 案台上的大铁盆砸在地上，发出震耳欲聋的巨响。瓦西里被巨响刺激，猛地扭过头，浑浊的眼睛锁定了站在门口的阿列克谢，嘶吼着扑了过来！
lines.en: The great iron basin on the table hits the floor with a deafening clang. The noise jolts Vasily: his head snaps round, his clouded eyes fix on Aleksei in the doorway, and he lunges with a shriek.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢被撞得倒退数步，后背狠狠砸在冷藏柜锋利的铁角上，剧痛让他眼前一黑。瓦西里的力气大得惊人，滚烫的双手死死掐住了阿列克谢的脖子，口水和带血的泡沫滴在阿列克谢的镜片上。
lines.en: The blow drives Aleksei back several steps; his spine strikes the sharp iron corner of the cold-storage cabinet, and the pain blacks out his sight. Vasily's strength is terrifying. His scalding hands lock around Aleksei's throat, and spittle and bloody foam drip onto the lenses of his glasses.

lines.zh: 空气被一点点抽离。阿列克谢的右手在油腻的砧板上胡乱摸索，手指触到了一个冰冷沉重的木柄——那是费奥多尔砍冻猪肉用的宽背砍骨刀。
lines.en: The air is drawn out of him bit by bit. Aleksei's right hand gropes blindly over the greasy chopping block, and his fingers close on a cold, heavy wooden handle — Fyodor's broad-backed cleaver for frozen pork.

lines.zh: 生死只在一瞬。恐惧彻底压垮了理智。
lines.en: Life and death turn on a single instant. Fear breaks reason utterly.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢猛地抽出砍骨刀，借着下坠的力量，自下而上用尽全身力气劈了出去！
lines.en: Aleksei snatches the cleaver free and, riding the downward pull, drives it upward with all the strength in his body.

lines.zh: 咔嚓！
lines.en: Crack!

lines.zh: 厚重的生锈刀刃准确地楔进了瓦西里的左侧锁骨窝，深陷进骨缝之中。
lines.en: The heavy, rusted blade wedges true into the hollow above Vasily's left collarbone, sinking deep between the bones.

lines.zh: 扑击的力量戛然而止。
lines.en: The force of the lunge stops dead.

lines.zh: 滚烫的血像打开的阀门一样喷涌而出，溅了阿列克谢满脸。瓦西里喉咙里的嘶吼停住了。随着大量鲜血的流失，他眼眶里那层紫黑色的血翳像是退潮一般迅速消散，露出了底下原本清澈明亮的浅蓝色眼珠。
lines.en: Scalding blood gushes out as though a valve had been opened, spattering Aleksei's face. The rasp in Vasily's throat ceases. As the blood drains away, the purple-black film in his eyes recedes like an ebbing tide, laying bare the clear, bright pale-blue eyes beneath.

lines.zh: 那个狂暴的“怪物”在两秒钟之内消失了。靠在阿列克谢肩头的，变成了一个刚满二十岁、眼神里充满惊恐与茫然的年轻木讷工棚小伙。
lines.en: The Rabid “monster” is gone within two seconds. What slumps against Aleksei's shoulder is a slow, gangly young bunkhouse lad just turned twenty, his eyes full of terror and bewilderment.

lines.zh: 瓦西里看着阿列克谢，嘴唇剧烈颤抖着，喉咙里咕噜作响，用尽最后的力气吐出了一个含混不清的俄语词汇：
lines.en: Vasily looks at Aleksei, lips shuddering, throat gurgling, and with his last strength forces out one slurred Russian word:

lines.stage: （眼神涣散，瞳孔放大）
lines.en: “...Пить... (Water... thirsty...)”

lines.zh: 他的头垂了下来，重重地砸在阿列克谢的肩膀上，再也没有动弹。
lines.en: His head drops forward, lands heavily on Aleksei's shoulder, and never moves again.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢双手握着刀柄，浑身筛糠般发抖。他想把刀拔出来，但刀刃被锁骨死死卡住，稍一用力，就发出令人骨髓发冷的骨头摩擦声。
lines.en: Aleksei grips the handle in both hands, shaking like a leaf in a gale. He tries to pull the blade out, but the collarbone holds it fast; the least effort brings a grating of bone that chills the marrow.

lines.zh: 费奥多尔跌跌撞撞地爬过来，噗通一声跪在儿子身边。老人没有扑上来打阿列克谢，只是伸出颤抖的双手，摸了摸儿子渐渐冰凉的脸颊。
lines.en: Fyodor stumbles over and drops with a thud to his knees beside his son. He does not throw himself at Aleksei; he only reaches out with trembling hands and touches his son's cooling cheek.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢落下了终生无法痊愈的心理创伤——创伤性干渴耳鸣。每当他在极度紧张或深夜潜行时，耳边便会反复轰鸣着骨裂声，以及那个在血泊中微弱求饶的词句：“Пить……”
lines.en: Aleksei is left with a psychological wound that will never heal — PTSD Thirst Tinnitus. Whenever he is under extreme strain or moving in the small hours, his ears ring again with the crack of splitting bone, and with that faint word of pleading from the pool of blood: “Пить...”

2-2.title_en: The Cleaver in the Kitchen and Vasily's Thirst

2-3.title: 回访后厨与背负的权利

lines.zh: 两天后的深夜。气温降至零下三十四度。
lines.en: Late at night, two days later. The temperature has fallen to minus thirty-four.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢顶着高烧，独自一人重新回到了东街工人食堂的后厨。他的棉大衣内侧藏着他在黑市用两瓶高纯度医用酒精换来的三小袋黑麦粉。
lines.en: Running a high fever, Aleksei returns alone to the kitchen of the East Street Workers' Canteen. Inside his padded coat he carries three small bags of rye flour, traded on the black market for two bottles of high-purity medical alcohol.

lines.zh: 后厨的水已经冻成了结实的黑冰。费奥多尔老爹坐在灶台旁，身上披着一件旧羊皮袄。瓦西里的遗体已经被抬到了案台上，盖着一条洗得发白的粗帆布，露出一双穿着破胶鞋的脚。
lines.en: The water on the kitchen floor has frozen into solid black ice. Old Fyodor sits beside the stove in an old sheepskin coat. Vasily's body has been laid out on the table under a faded coarse canvas, leaving a pair of feet in broken rubber shoes exposed.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢走到老人面前，两腿一软，跪在满是凝固血污的冰面上。
lines.en: Aleksei comes up to the old man; his legs give way, and he kneels on the ice crusted over with dried blood.

lines.zh: 费奥多尔大叔……打死我吧。瓦西里冲出来的时候脚底下踩滑了……我手里握着撬棍，我本可以砸他的膝盖……可我害怕了，我挑了最省事的砍骨刀。
lines.stage: （低下头，把装面粉的布袋推到老人脚边，声音沙哑得几乎听不清）
lines.en: Uncle Fyodor... beat me to death. Vasily slipped as he came at me... I had the crowbar in my hand; I could have smashed his knees... but I was afraid. I took the easy way — the cleaver.

lines.zh: 老人很久没有出声。屋子里只有北风灌进烟囱的呜咽声。
lines.en: For a long time the old man says nothing. The only sound in the room is the north wind whining down the chimney.

lines.zh: 过了很久，一只粗糙、布满烫伤硬茧的大手落在了阿列克谢被雪打湿的头顶上。老人没有拿刀，也没有把面粉扔出去。他站起身，走到瓦西里的遗体旁，从旁边叠着的衣服堆里拿起了一件带补丁的深灰色厚棉坎肩。那是瓦西里生前干活时常穿的。
lines.en: After a long while, a rough hand, calloused with old burns, settles on Aleksei's snow-wet head. The old man takes up no knife, nor does he fling the flour away. He rises, walks over to Vasily's body, and from the pile of folded clothes beside it takes a patched, dark-grey, thickly padded vest — the one Vasily used to wear for his work.

lines.zh: 费奥多尔把坎肩披在了阿列克谢不住发抖的肩膀上。
lines.en: Fyodor lays the vest over Aleksei's ceaselessly trembling shoulders.

lines.zh: 他临死前喊渴，你记着这声渴就行。别拿‘他是疯子’来安慰自己，那是我儿子。
lines.en: He cried out for water as he died. Just hold on to that thirst. Don't comfort yourself with “he had gone mad.” He was my son.

lines.zh: 老人指了指阿列克谢怀里露出一角的工作日志。
lines.en: The old man points at the corner of the work logbook showing inside Aleksei's coat.

lines.zh: 他叫瓦西里·费奥多罗维奇。写进去。写他是个活人，二十岁，机务段的三级司炉工。等全城的门砸开那天，你当着大伙的面，把他的名字念出来。
lines.en: His name was Vasily Fyodorovich. Write it in. Write that he was a living man, twenty years old, a third-grade fireman in the locomotive depot. On the day the doors of every city building are beaten down, you stand before the crowd and say his name aloud.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢跪在地上，眼泪混着血水砸在冰面上。他翻开日志背面，在谢尔盖的名字下方，一笔一划地写下了瓦西里的全名。
lines.en: Aleksei remains on his knees, tears mingled with blood striking the ice. He turns the logbook over and, beneath Sergei's name, writes out Vasily's full name, stroke by careful stroke.

2-3.title_en: Return to the Kitchen and the Right to Bear It

2-4.title: 旧疗养院与《回退手稿》

lines.zh: 旧传染病疗养院地下二层。
lines.en: Old Infectious Disease Sanatorium, second basement level.

lines.zh: 这里曾经是结核病隔离病区，阴暗潮湿的水泥墙上结满了白色的硝霜。空气中弥漫着高浓度石炭酸与腐烂组织的怪味。
lines.en: This was once a tuberculosis isolation ward; white nitrate frost has bloomed across the dark, damp concrete. The air is heavy with the strange reek of strong carbolic acid and rotting tissue.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢穿过堆满铁架床的走廊，在一间焊着厚铁栏杆的配药室里见到了前铁路医院副院长梁诺夫医生，以及他的学生、流调员古丽娅。
lines.en: Aleksei passes down a corridor heaped with iron-framed beds and finds Dr. Leonov, former deputy director of the railway hospital, together with his student, the epidemiologist Gulya, in a dispensary room behind thick welded iron bars.

lines.zh: 在靠墙的一张铁床上，用医用牛皮带死死绑着一个年轻女孩。女孩整整昏迷了三天，手腕被皮带磨得皮开肉绽。但此刻，她身上的高热正在消退，原本硬化如蛇皮的灰白角质正大片大片地从胸口和颈部剥落，露出底下粉红色的新生皮肤。女孩正发出虚弱但均匀的呼吸声。
lines.en: On an iron bed against the wall a young girl is bound fast with medical leather straps. She has been unconscious for three full days, her wrists rubbed raw by the belts. But now her fever is breaking: the grey-white keratin, hardened like snakeskin, is sloughing off her chest and neck in great sheets, revealing pink new skin beneath. Her breathing is faint but even.

lines.zh: 古丽娅医师眼睛通红，手里紧紧攥着三页薄薄的病历纸，纸角浸透了黄褐色的药水污渍。
lines.en: Dr. Gulya's eyes are red-rimmed; she clutches three thin sheets of case notes in her hand, their corners soaked through with yellow-brown medicine stains.

lines.zh: 第三十七例！阿廖沙，这是第三十七例完整记录！只要给他们水，熬过第四天的高热神经风暴，灰鳞就会剥落！这不是绝症，它是一种远古孢子引发的急性自限性肺泡炎！人能自己挺过来！
lines.stage: （把病历纸塞到阿列克谢眼前，手指由于激动而泛白）
lines.en: The thirty-seventh case! Alyosha, this is the thirty-seventh complete record! Give them water, let them live through the fourth-day fever storm, and the Grey Scale sloughs away! This is no terminal illness — it is an acute self-limiting alveolitis brought on by an ancient spore! People can pull through on their own!

lines.zh: 阿列克谢接过那三页《回退临床手稿》。上面的每一行数据、每一个体温曲线，都用蓝黑墨水记录得清清楚楚。但在最后一页的末尾，盖着一个刺眼的红色长方形印章：【退回 · 结论含有动摇防线内容 · 不予归档】。
lines.en: Aleksei takes the three pages of the Clinical Regression Manuscript. Every line of data, every temperature curve, is set down plainly in blue-black ink. But at the foot of the last page is a glaring red rectangular stamp: [REJECTED · CONCLUSIONS CONTAIN MATERIAL THAT UNDERMINES THE LINE · NOT TO BE FILED].

lines.zh: 三天前，我把手稿交给了督察专员。他甚至没翻开第二页，直接当着我的面扔进了碎纸炉。他说：‘梁诺夫同志，布拉风号已经拉走了四千人，乌拉尔山线已经平了四千笔账。如果你的报告是真的，那四千个被销账的人算什么？’
lines.stage: （坐在药箱上，用止血钳夹着棉球擦拭眼镜）
lines.en: Three days ago I handed the manuscript to the inspector. He did not even open the second page — he threw it into the shredder before my eyes. He said: “Comrade Leonov, the armoured train Buran has already carried away four thousand people, and the Ural line has balanced four thousand accounts. If your report is true, what does that make those four thousand written-off souls?”

lines.zh: 老医生的手停在半空，眼眶凹陷。
lines.en: The old doctor's hand hangs motionless in mid-air; his eyes are sunken in their sockets.

lines.zh: 他们不是不知道人能好起来。他们是不能让活着的人好起来。活着的人一退烧，他们手里的枪和单子就全成了杀人罪证。
lines.en: It is not that they don't know people can get better. They cannot allow the living to get better. The moment a living person's fever breaks, the guns and the forms in their hands become evidence of murder.

lines.zh: 铁床上的女孩突然发出了一声微弱的呻吟。阿列克谢猛地转过头——那是安娜（档案号 0419）。
lines.en: The girl on the iron bed lets out a faint moan. Aleksei whips his head round — it is Anna (file 0419).

lines.zh: 安娜艰难地睁开眼睛，瞳孔清澈透明。她看着阿列克谢胸前挂着的铁路调度工牌，又看了看阿列克谢大衣口袋里露出的妹妹照片，干裂的嘴唇吃力地开合：
lines.en: Anna opens her eyes with an effort, her pupils clear and transparent. She looks at the railway dispatcher's badge hanging on Aleksei's chest, then at the photograph of his sister showing in his coat pocket, and her cracked lips part with difficulty:

lines.zh: ……照片……0420……是拉娜护士吗？
lines.en: “...The photograph... 0420... is that Nurse Lana?”

lines.zh: 阿列克谢像触电一样冲到铁床边，单膝跪地。
lines.en: Aleksei rushes to the iron bed as though struck by lightning and drops to one knee.

lines.zh: 你见过她？！拉娜在哪儿？！
lines.en: You've seen her?! Where is Lana?!

lines.zh: 在第三节车厢……三天前，我们在同一个留观站……她帮我把水壶藏在靴筒里……她手上的灰鳞也掉了，她一直在哭，她说她哥在货运站，她哥一定会去接她……然后清杀队就来了，把我们像牲口一样赶上了铁皮车……我因为休克被当成死人扔下了站台……她还在车里……
lines.en: In Carriage No. 3... three days ago we were at the same observation station... she helped me hide my water flask in my boot... the Grey Scale had fallen from her hands too, and she kept crying, saying her brother was at the freight depot, that her brother would surely come for her... then the OSK came and herded us onto the boxcar like cattle... I went into shock and they threw me off the platform as dead... she's still in there...

2-4.choices_markdown:
**【抉择 B · 手稿的归宿】**
- **B1（上交督察组）**：阿列克谢在巨大的恐惧下，把手稿交给了内务巡逻队换取两瓶腹透液。真相被彻底掩埋。日志背面划下血痕“|”。（**良知▼**，真结局关闭）。
- **B2（贴身保存）**：阿列克谢将三页手稿折好，缝进了自己棉大衣内胆贴近心口的位置：“老院长，只要我阿廖沙还有一口气，这几页纸就不会变成灰。”（**真相存活**，**良知▲**）。
- **B3（交老轨伊万）**：阿列克谢带手稿潜往黑市，交给老伊万通过铁路秘密线路翻印扩散。（**真相存活**）。

## 第三幕：断管分水岭与松林庄园的夜宴（双线分流与大审判官）

- **关卡代号**：L06 – L07
- **场景**：602 室分水岭（白昼）→ 废弃铁路黑市（夜）→ 叶莲娜的秘密广播点 → 松林庄园二号恒温特供库（黑区）
- **时间**：Z 年 12 月初
- **登场人物**：阿列克谢、卡佳妈妈、老轨伊万、黑市假药贩、茹科夫专员、后勤处长维克多、特勤队员
- **核心机制**：腹膜透析极限倒计时、供暖断绝严寒惩罚、黑区警戒与焚化炉环境隐蔽
2-4.title_en: The Old Sanatorium and the Regression Manuscript

3-1.title: 第八章的分水岭

lines.zh: 极夜的寒潮提前降临，室外气温跌破零下三十八度。
lines.en: The polar night's cold wave came early; the temperature outside fell below minus thirty-eight degrees.

lines.zh: 市政集中供暖管道在一声巨响后爆裂，高压蒸汽将整条街笼罩在白茫茫的死雾中，随后彻底冷却。赫鲁晓夫楼的铸铁暖气片在半小时内结了一层厚厚的白霜。
lines.en: The municipal heating main burst with a great bang; high-pressure steam shrouded the whole street in a blank white fog of death, then went cold for good. Within half an hour the cast-iron radiators of the Khrushchyovka were coated in a thick white frost.

lines.zh: 602 室的透析机由于电压骤降发出尖锐的报警蜂鸣。最后一袋瑞士 409 批腹膜透析液在昨夜用尽。
lines.en: In Room 602 the dialysis machine shrieked a sharp alarm as the voltage plunged. The last bag of Swiss Batch-409 peritoneal dialysis fluid had run out the night before.

3-1.choices_markdown:
**【剧情分水岭判定：母亲的生死】**

- **分支 α（卡佳妈妈存活线）**：
  若玩家在前七章成功保住了至少三袋透析液并维持了室内临时煤炉供暖。阿列克谢在凌晨将换来的透析液接上管道。卡佳妈妈虽然极度虚弱，但呼吸逐渐平稳。她握住儿子的手：“去吧，阿廖沙……去把拉娜找回来……妈看着炉子，妈等你。”阿列克谢将家门钥匙贴身收好，转身踏入风雪。（进入**家园线**）。

- **分支 β（卡佳妈妈去世 · 失母荒原线）**：
  若透析液断供超过四十八小时。当阿列克谢推开门时，透析机已经显示长鸣的红字。床上的母亲蜷缩成一团，体重在尿毒症与极寒中消耗得只剩下七十二斤。卡佳妈妈在临终前拔掉了腹部的插管，把那床旧羊毛毯整整齐齐地叠在床头，留下一张被铅笔字擦花的硬纸片：*“阿廖沙，别换药了，换车票。带拉娜去南边。”*
  阿列克谢在冻得如铁板一样的床前跪了整整两个小时。他没有哭，只是默默脱下大衣，将母亲抱下六楼，安放在废弃洗车库避风的雪坑里。他用撬棍把 602 室的铁门彻底反锁，拔出钥匙扔进暴风雪中。心死之人的夜潜，变成了一场无所顾忌的复仇与寻死。

3-2.title: 黑市 6.66 MHz 与老轨的路线图

lines.zh: 午夜。废弃机车调车库。
lines.en: Midnight. The abandoned locomotive roundhouse.

lines.zh: 这里是诺沃斯克-17 最后的地下黑市。几台锈迹斑斑的蒸汽机车之间，支着几十个低矮的帆布窝棚。几个冻得鼻涕横流的药贩子正围着一台老式矿石收音机，喇叭里正以极其隐蔽的杂音播放着调频 6.66 MHz 的循环暗号：【六六六……土豆换鳞粉……烙铁保平安……】
lines.en: This was the last underground black market in Novorsk-17. Between several rust-eaten steam locomotives stood dozens of low canvas stalls. A few drug peddlers, their noses running with the cold, huddled around an old crystal radio; from its speaker, hidden under a veil of static, came a repeating code on 6.66 MHz: [Six-six-six... potatoes for scale-powder... the branding iron keeps you safe...]

lines.zh: 在车厢暗处，一个假药贩正将一根烧得通红的火烙铁按在一个工人的手背上。焦糊的人肉臭味伴随着惨叫声散开，工人原本轻微起鳞的手背被硬生生烫成一片焦黑的烂肉。
lines.en: In the dark of a boxcar, a fake-medicine peddler was pressing a red-hot branding iron against a worker's hand. The reek of scorched flesh spread with the man's screams; the back of his hand, where the scales had only just begun to show, was seared into a charred mass of raw meat.

lines.zh: 喊什么喊！烫成三级烧伤，清杀队的刮片枪就刮不出孢子反应！这就叫‘工业事故’，懂不懂？不然明早直接拉上铁壳号！
lines.stage: （收走工人的手表，冷笑）
lines.en: What are you screaming for! Burn it to a third-degree burn and the OSK scraper-guns won't get any spore reaction! That's what we call an 'industrial accident' - understand? Otherwise tomorrow morning they'll drag you straight onto the armoured train Buran!

lines.zh: 阿列克谢一把推开帘子，灰烬冲上去露出一口森白的犬齿，吓得药贩子缩进煤堆。
lines.en: Aleksei flung the curtain aside; Ash lunged forward, baring a mouth of glistening white fangs, and the peddler shrank back into the coal heap.

lines.zh: 机车驾驶室里，老轨伊万正坐在悬空的铁座上，就着一听发绿的腌酸黄瓜喝着烈性工业酒精。
lines.en: In the locomotive cab, Old Ivan sat on a hanging iron seat, drinking potent industrial alcohol and chasing it with a tin of green pickles.

lines.zh: 小子，布拉风号今晚二十三点整挂尾车。内务部特勤连压车，第三节闷罐车厢里装了一百七十六个退了烧的活人，终点不是什么疗养所，是乌拉尔鹰嘴崖 3 号废弃矿坑。他们要在那里用铝热剂炸山灭口。你妹妹就在那节车厢里。
lines.stage: （把一张浸透机油的列车时刻表拍在仪表盘上）
lines.en: Listen, kid. The Buran takes its tail car at twenty-three hundred tonight. A Ministry of Internal Affairs special-duty company is riding guard; the third boxcar holds a hundred and seventy-six people whose fevers have broken - still alive. Their destination isn't some sanatorium, it's the abandoned No. 3 mine pit at Eagle's Crag in the Urals. They're going to bring the mountain down with thermite and silence them all. Your sister is in that very boxcar.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢抓起时刻表，指节发白。
lines.en: Aleksei snatched up the timetable, his knuckles white.

lines.zh: 你怎么混进编组站的？
lines.en: How did you get into the marshalling yard?

lines.zh: 老子在西伯利亚开这趟鬼车开了二十五年！每节车厢的制动气阀在哪儿，老子闭着眼都能摸着。我只能在鹰嘴崖大弯道帮你把紧急制动闸拉下一半。能不能撬开门把人拖出来，看你自己的造化。
lines.stage: （吐了口浓痰）
lines.en: Twenty-five years I've driven this ghost train across Siberia! I can find the brake air valve on every car with my eyes shut. At Eagle's Crag, on the big curve, all I can do is pull the emergency brake halfway for you. Whether you can pry that door open and drag them out - that's down to your own luck.

3-2.title_en: The Black Market at 6.66 MHz and Old Ivan's Route Map

3-2A.title: 六点六六兆赫与秘密广播点

lines.zh: 黑市收音机反复播出的杂音里藏着一串不属于药贩的短波节拍。阿列克谢沿着信号穿过废弃检修巷，在一间封死窗户的旧信号室里找到发射机。电池、手摇发电柄和几张被压在旋钮下的庄园平面图说明，这里有人持续工作了很久。
lines.en: Hidden in the static the black-market radio kept repeating was a shortwave rhythm that did not belong to the peddlers. Aleksei traced the signal through an abandoned maintenance alley and found the transmitter in an old signal room with its windows sealed shut. The batteries, the hand-cranked generator handle, and several manor floor plans wedged beneath the dials all said someone had been working here a long time.

lines.zh: 门后的女人没有举枪。她先关掉发射机，再把监听耳机摘下来。她是茹科夫专员的女儿叶莲娜，也是这条秘密广播的架设者。她用低功率信号向城外的医疗救援频道通报退烧者仍然活着；她保留了一条从排污检修管进入松林庄园的路线。
lines.en: The woman behind the door did not raise a gun. She switched off the transmitter first, then took off her monitoring headphones. She was Yelena, Commissioner Zhukov's daughter - and the one who had built this secret broadcast. On a low-power signal she reported to the medical rescue channel outside the city that those whose fevers had broken were still alive; she had kept a route into Pine Manor through the sewage maintenance duct.

lines.zh: 叶莲娜留着金色长发，穿着剪裁合身、面料厚实的冬季外套，领口的毛边和袖口都打理得干净。她看起来比外面的人体面许多，但脸上没有庄园里那种安稳。
lines.en: Yelena wore her fair hair long and a well-tailored winter coat of heavy cloth, the fur trim at the collar and cuffs kept clean. She looked far more presentable than the people outside, yet there was none of the manor's ease on her face.

lines.zh: 你听见的不是求救，是我在确认谁还肯回应。庄园有我父亲的账本，也有你要找的车厢记录。排污管能送你进去，但我不再替他把活人写成零。
lines.stage: （把频率表推到桌子中央）
lines.en: What you heard wasn't a call for help. I was checking who still dared to answer. The manor has my father's ledgers, and the carriage records you're looking for. The sewage duct can get you in - but I won't be the one to write living people down as zeros for him again.

lines.zh: 你知道这会让你失去什么吗？
lines.en: Do you know what this will cost you?

lines.zh: 知道。先把门打开，出去以后再算。
lines.en: I know. Open the door first - we'll settle it once we're outside.

3-2A.choices_markdown:
**【抉择 3-2A：接过频率表】**
- **带叶莲娜同行**：阿列克谢接过频率表。叶莲娜加入队伍；她可以命令最近且视线可达的 OSK 停步 8 秒，冷却 25 秒。她给出的排污路线解锁松林庄园。
- **拒绝她的帮助**：阿列克谢只抄下排污路线，不让叶莲娜同行。松林庄园仍可进入，但她不会成为伙伴。
3-2A.title_en: 6.66 MHz and the Secret Broadcast Post

3-3.title: 松林庄园的夜宴与茹科夫的账本

lines.zh: 松林庄园。这里是铁路局干部特供区。
lines.en: Pine Manor. This was the privileged compound of the railway bureau's cadres.

lines.zh: 与外面零下三十度的严寒截然相反，四米高压电网阻隔的高墙内，暖气片烧得滚烫，室内温度高达二十六度。
lines.en: In brutal contrast to the minus-thirty cold outside, inside the high walls behind a four-metre high-voltage electric fence the radiators ran scalding hot and the air reached twenty-six degrees.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢穿过排污管潜入二号恒温特供库。刺眼的白炽灯下，码放着整齐划一的瑞士进口 409 批透析液、精制白面粉、整箱的新西兰黄油与带大理石花纹的冷冻牛排。
lines.en: Aleksei slipped through the sewage duct into the No. 2 climate-controlled store. Beneath the glare of incandescent lamps stood neat rows of Swiss-imported Batch-409 dialysis fluid, refined white flour, crated New Zealand butter, and frozen steaks marbled with fat.

lines.zh: 后勤处长维克多正指挥着四个穿白色防化服的工人，将一整推车临期的腹膜透析液和牛排推进熊熊燃烧的工业焚化炉。黑色油腻的焦烟顺着高耸的烟囱排向夜空，化作整座城市上空飘落的焦油黑雪。
lines.en: Logistics Chief Viktor was directing four workers in white chemical-protection suits as they shovelled a whole cartload of near-expiry peritoneal dialysis fluid and steaks into a roaring industrial incinerator. Black, greasy smoke climbed the towering chimney into the night sky and turned into tar-black snow drifting down over the whole city.

lines.zh: 全城每天为了半茶匙碎麦子去告密，你们把救命的药往炉子里填？！
lines.stage: （从阴影中踏出，手里的道钉撬棍直指维克多）
lines.en: The whole city informs on its neighbours every day for half a teaspoon of cracked grain - and you're shovelling life-saving medicine into the furnace?!

lines.zh: 维克多吓得倒退撞翻了推车。阴影里，松林庄园特权区主管茹科夫专员端着茶杯慢慢走了出来。他穿着剪裁合身的毛呢制服，脸上没有凶恶，只有一种深入骨髓的疲惫与冷淡。
lines.en: Viktor recoiled in fright and knocked over the cart. Out of the shadows came Commissioner Zhukov, the man who oversaw the privileged zone of Pine Manor, a teacup in his hand. He wore a well-tailored wool uniform, and there was no cruelty on his face - only a weariness and coldness that went to the bone.

lines.zh: 莫罗佐夫调度员。你以为我是个贪污犯？还是个以杀人为乐的疯子？
lines.stage: （吹了吹茶水上的浮沫，示意工人继续往炉子里铲）
lines.en: Dispatcher Morozov. Do you take me for an embezzler? Or a madman who kills for pleasure?

lines.zh: 茹科夫拉开抽屉，掏出一本盖满公章的配给审计总账，扔在阿列克谢脚下。
lines.en: Zhukov pulled out a drawer, took out a ration-audit master ledger stamped all over with official seals, and threw it down at Aleksei's feet.

lines.zh: 诺沃斯克-17 的主管道早就烂透了。主脑算得很清楚：煤炭储备只够撑三十天，药品只够供应六百人，而城里焊死在筒子楼里的活人有整整四万。如果不把三万人打成‘已注销’，如果不把他们送进矿坑，全城的蒸汽三天之内就会彻底耗尽。到时候，所有人——包括你、你妈、我和我的女儿，全都会冻死在床板上。三十箱药分给三百人，你信不信今晚半夜他们就能拿菜刀互相把门砸烂？……我不是恶人，莫罗佐夫。恶人早冻死了，留下来的是算账的。把门焊死，牺牲一部分人，剩下的至少能活到开春。
lines.en: Novorsk-17's main pipeline rotted through long ago. The central brain worked it out precisely: the coal reserves would last thirty days, the medicine could supply six hundred people - and there were forty thousand living people sealed into the Khrushchyovka blocks. Unless thirty thousand of them were written off as 'deregistered', unless they were sent into the mines, the city's steam would be utterly exhausted within three days. When that happened, everyone - you, your mother, me, my daughter - would freeze to death on their bedboards. Divide thirty crates of medicine among three hundred people, and I promise you, by midnight tonight they'd be battering down each other's doors with kitchen knives. ... I'm not a villain, Morozov. The villains froze to death long ago. What's left are the ones who keep the accounts. Weld the doors shut, sacrifice a portion, and the rest may live at least until spring.

lines.zh: 可第三节车厢里的人，他们的烧已经退了！他们是活人！
lines.stage: （握紧撬棍，声音像从冰缝里挤出来）
lines.en: But the people in the third carriage - their fevers have broken! They're alive!

lines.zh: 在电传机里，划掉的名字就是死人。如果他们是活人，那我们过去这一个月算什么？算刽子手？……莫罗佐夫，机器不能犯错。机器一犯错，整座城就会像雪崩一样塌掉。把枪放下，去地下室挑两箱牛排和一箱透析液带走，回你的 602 室去。就当这世上只有你母亲一个人。
lines.stage: （冷漠地看着他）
lines.en: On the teletype, a name crossed out is a dead man. If they're alive, then what have we been for the past month? Executioners? ... Morozov, the machine cannot make mistakes. Once the machine makes a mistake, the whole city comes down like an avalanche. Put the gun down, go down to the cellar, pick out two crates of steak and one of dialysis fluid, and take them back to your Room 602. Just pretend your mother is the only person left in the world.

3-3.choices_markdown:
**【抉择 C · 庄园的审判】**
- **C1（砸碎终端，抢药突围）**：阿列克谢一撬棍砸碎了焚化炉的温控电闸，抓起两袋急救透析液和药品样本，在警报声中跳窗遁入黑夜。（**良知▲**，获得关键证物【特供调拨底册】）。
- **C2（背叛逃民，妥协交换）**：阿列克谢接受了茹科夫的交易，指出地下室躲藏的老谢苗藏匿点以换取长期特供药配额。（**良知大跌**，日志划下一道深划痕“|”，真结局关闭）。
- **C3（破坏高压阀）**：阿列克谢拧开高压蒸汽排气阀制造大规模蒸汽爆炸，在浓烟中救走被囚禁的工人。（**良知▲**）。

## 第四幕：3 号矿坑：温压爆破与远古孢子（山体真相与净账）

- **关卡代号**：L07M
- **场景**：乌拉尔山脉支线 3 号废弃矿坑主斜井 → 爆破作业面 → 铝热剂起爆硐室
- **时间**：Z 年 12 月 3 日 · 特大暴风雪
- **登场人物**：阿列克谢、留守技术员博伊科、清杀队换岗小队
- **核心机制**：粉尘区屏息倒计时、滤毒罐磨损机制、环境塌方、铝热剂起爆总线拆除
3-3.title_en: The Night Banquet at Pine Manor and Commissioner Zhukov's Ledger

4-1.title: 千层糕断面与远古粉尘

lines.zh: 暴风雪中的 3 号矿坑像大山被剖开的一道流脓的巨口。
lines.en: In the blizzard, No. 3 pit was like a great festering maw split open in the mountain.

lines.zh: 主斜井深达地下两百米，轨道两侧散落着扭曲变形的矿车和风钻。这里的空气极其浑浊，手电筒的光柱照过去，空气中弥漫着无数微小闪烁的灰黑色荧光粉尘。
lines.en: The main incline ran two hundred metres underground, its rails littered on both sides with twisted mine carts and pneumatic drills. The air here was foul and thick; in the beam of a torch, countless tiny glittering grey-black fluorescent particles drifted through it.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢换上了帕沙给的滤毒罐，面罩内侧立刻传来粗重闷热的呼吸声。灰烬走在前面，尾巴紧紧夹在两腿之间，它对着岩壁低声呜咽——那粉尘里有一种令人窒息的死寂，但没有任何狂暴的气息。
lines.en: Aleksei fitted the filter canister Pasha had given him; at once his own heavy, hot breathing filled the inside of the mask. Ash walked ahead, tail clamped tight between its legs, whimpering low at the rock wall - there was a suffocating dead stillness in that dust, but no trace of Rabid fury.

lines.zh: 下潜到作业面最深处，一座被温压炸药炸开的巨大地质断面横亘在眼前。
lines.en: At the deepest part of the working face, a huge geological section blasted open by thermobaric charges lay stretched out before him.

lines.zh: 断面如同被切开的千层糕：上面是黑色的煤系地层，中间是冻结了数万年的淡蓝永冻冰层，而在永冻层最深处，一道宽达数米的暗红色脉络被炸得粉碎，无数细密的灰白菌丝正从岩缝中渗出。
lines.en: The section was like a layer cake sliced open: on top, black coal-bearing strata; in the middle, a pale-blue permafrost ice layer frozen for tens of thousands of years; and at the very bottom of the permafrost, a dark-red vein several metres wide had been blown to pieces, countless fine grey-white fungal filaments oozing out of the cracks in the rock.

lines.zh: 岩壁上用红油漆刷着巨大的庆功标语：【向十月献礼：深层冻土温压爆破掘进贯通！】
lines.en: On the rock wall, huge characters in red paint proclaimed the celebration slogan: [An Offering to October: Deep Permafrost Thermobaric Blasting Drives the Tunnel Through!]

lines.zh:
在贯通作业面的岩壁脚下，凌乱地刻满了矿工用凿子凿出的简短字句：
“瓦尼亚，别管我，带你弟跑。”
“打穿了。山里冒灰烟了。”
“不是煤，是粉。吸进去心口发烧。”
lines.en:
At the foot of the rock wall at the breakthrough face, the miners had scratched short lines roughly with their chisels:
'Vanya, don't mind me - run, take your little brother.'
'We broke through. Grey smoke's coming out of the mountain.'
'It isn't coal, it's dust. Breathe it in and your chest burns.'

lines.zh: 阿列克谢伸出戴着胶皮手套的手指，在断面边缘捻了捻那层粉末。
lines.en: Aleksei reached out a rubber-gloved finger and rubbed at the powder along the edge of the exposed face.

lines.zh: 病根本不是境外敌对势力的生化袭击，也不是什么天降的神罚。
lines.en: The sickness was no biological attack by hostile forces abroad, and no punishment sent from heaven.

lines.zh: 是官僚为了赶在节日指标前贯通铁路，不顾地质警告，强行动用温压爆破炸穿了万年永冻土，释放了深埋在冻土层下的远古真菌孢子！
lines.en: It was bureaucrats, determined to drive the railway through ahead of the holiday quota, ignoring every geological warning, who forced a thermobaric blast through the ten-thousand-year permafrost and released the ancient fungal spores buried deep beneath it!

4-1.title_en: The Layer-Cake Cross-Section and the Ancient Dust

4-2.title: 博伊科的起爆器与净账

lines.zh: 运输大巷拐角的调度硐室里，电石灯发出刺啦刺啦的暗黄光线。
lines.en: In the dispatcher's chamber at the bend of the main haulage way, a carbide lamp hissed with dim yellow light.

lines.zh: 十几箱军用铝热剂燃烧装药整整齐齐地码放在轨道两侧，起爆电缆一直连接到工作台上一台绿色的十路手摇起爆器上。
lines.en: A dozen or more crates of military thermite incendiary charges were stacked in neat rows along both sides of the rails, their firing cable running all the way to a green ten-circuit hand-cranked detonator on the workbench.

lines.zh: 留守技术员博伊科正瘫坐在起爆器旁。他扯开了领口，脖颈上布满了大片正在剥落的灰白角质硬鳞，胸口剧烈起伏，伴随着撕心裂肺的呛咳。他的手背通红，体温计摔碎在脚边，水银珠滚进了煤渣里。
lines.en: Boyko, the technician left on watch, sat slumped beside the detonator. He had torn open his collar; his neck was covered in broad patches of grey-white keratinous hard scales, flaking off, and his chest heaved with wrenching, choking coughs. The backs of his hands were scarlet, a broken thermometer lay at his feet, its mercury beads rolling into the coal slag.

lines.zh: 看见手持撬棍的阿列克谢，博伊科没有去摸手枪，只是疲倦地把额头抵在冰冷的铁桌面上。
lines.en: Seeing Aleksei with the crowbar in his hand, Boyko did not reach for his pistol; he only rested his forehead wearily against the cold iron tabletop.

lines.zh: ……你也是被逼着来装药的？……别费劲了，电缆我已经接过来了。
lines.stage: （咳出一口带血的黑痰）
lines.en: ...They forced you to come and plant the charges too? ... Don't bother. I've already wired the cable.

lines.zh: 内务部下令炸山？
lines.stage: （用手电照向墙上的工程图纸）
lines.en: The Ministry of Internal Affairs ordered the mountain blown up?

lines.zh: 上面说……只要炸塌这条巷道，把孢子断面彻底封死，矿上就没事了，外面的人也不用天天查体温了。任务代号叫‘净账’……多好听的名词啊。只要山一塌，把里面的一百七十六个人一起埋在里头，账面上的人数和实存人数就彻底‘闭合’了。可我儿子就在里头的掘进二队……他才十九岁，昨天他的高烧刚退下去，他还隔着铁门管我要烟抽……阿廖沙……我按不下去这颗雷管，可我也拆不掉它。巡逻队还有十五分钟交班，我要是没按，他们进来就会把我和我儿子一起当成感染者用喷火器烧死……
lines.stage: （惨笑了一声，声音虚弱嘶哑）
lines.en: They said upstairs... if we just bring this gallery down and seal off the spore face completely, the mine will be in the clear, and the people outside won't have to take their temperatures every day. The operation is codenamed 'Clean Ledger'... what a pretty name. Once the mountain falls and buries all hundred and seventy-six people inside, the numbers on the ledger and the numbers actually alive will be 'closed' for good. But my boy is in there, in No. 2 tunnelling team... he's only nineteen, his fever broke just yesterday, and he was asking me for a cigarette through the iron door... Alyosha... I can't press this detonator, and I can't disarm it either. The patrol changes shift in fifteen minutes - if I don't press it, they'll come in and burn my son and me both as infected with flamethrowers...

4-2.choices_markdown:
**【抉择 E · 矿坑的证物与起爆线】**
- **E1（带走孢子岩芯与台账）**：阿列克谢用撬棍凿下一块包含完整菌丝的深层岩芯，翻拍并装走了爆破工程台账。这成了终幕广播中击溃官僚谎言的铁证。（**获得【矿坑核心证物】**）。
- **E2（破坏起爆电路，救助博伊科）**：阿列克谢切断了总起爆电缆，将抗生素分给博伊科，背着他从通风天井转移。清杀队未能按计划炸山，被迫在第五幕改用常规步枪和燃烧弹在谷底强攻。（**良知▲**，改变第五幕战场形态）。
- **E3（仅取炸药撤退）**：中立搜刮，不承担证物负重。

## 第五幕：夜闸与鹰嘴崖底的第三节车厢（大火托孤与终局闸 D）

- **关卡代号**：L08 – L09
- **场景**：第 3 工人居住区大火楼道 → 乌拉尔山线鹰嘴崖脱轨深谷 → 侧翻的第三节车厢
- **时间**：决战之夜 · 极寒暴雪
- **登场人物**：阿列克谢、拉娜（妹妹）、柳德米拉大娘、外孙女佳娜、老钳工帕维尔、切尔诺夫中士、老轨伊万、清杀督察专员
- **核心机制**：浓烟限时救援、乙炔切门破拆、侧翻车厢“无 UI 沉浸交互”、004 铭牌直面、终局闸 D 三向抉择

5-1.title: 焊死的单元门与大火托孤

lines.zh: 出城决战的前夜。第 3 工人居住区一楼配电室发生严重过载短路，引燃了堆积在走廊里的废弃木料和废防化服。
lines.en: On the eve of the breakout, a severe overload short-circuited the ground-floor distribution room in Workers' District 3, setting fire to the scrap lumber and discarded chemical-protection suits stacked in the corridor.

lines.zh: 刺鼻的黑烟迅速顺着电梯井和楼梯通道向上倒灌，整栋赫鲁晓夫筒子楼化作一座封闭的炉膛。
lines.en: Acrid black smoke poured up through the elevator shaft and stairwells, turning the entire Khrushchyovka block into a sealed furnace.

lines.zh: 底楼唯一的消防出口外面，横焊着一根重达半吨的工字钢横梁——那是七天前为了“确保封控严密”由工程队焊死的。
lines.en: Across the building's only ground-floor fire exit lay a half-ton I-beam welded in place—seven days earlier, a work crew had sealed it there "to ensure the lockdown held tight."

lines.zh: 上百名居民被困在浓烟滚滚的楼梯缓台上，女人和孩子的尖叫声几乎撕裂夜空。墙上的应急对讲机里，区管委的电传系统依然在机械地循环播报：【火警破拆申请已受理 · 当前审批流转序号：47 · 请全体居民在户内就地等待】。
lines.en: More than a hundred residents were trapped on the smoke-choked stair landings, the screams of women and children all but tearing the night open. From the emergency intercom on the wall, the District Rationing Committee's teletype kept droning the same bulletin: [Fire-break application received · Current approval routing number: 47 · All residents are to remain indoors and wait].

lines.zh: 浓烟中，六十三岁的柳德米拉大娘被人群踩倒在三楼台阶上。她满脸黑灰，怀里死死护着五岁的外孙女佳娜。
lines.en: In the smoke, sixty-three-year-old Grandmother Lyudmila was trampled on the third-flight steps. Her face was black with soot; she shielded her five-year-old granddaughter Dyana against her chest.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢用湿毛巾捂住口鼻冲上楼梯，一把抓住了老人的胳膊。
lines.en: Aleksei charged up the stairs with a wet cloth over his mouth and nose and caught the old woman by the arm.

lines.zh: 柳德米拉剧烈咳嗽着，用力推开阿列克谢，把浑身发抖的小女孩硬生生推进了阿列克谢怀里。同时塞过来的，还有那张被大火熏黑的举报领粮券，上面的“告密者”三个黑字只剩下了半个残角。
lines.en: Lyudmila coughed violently, shoved Aleksei aside, and thrust the trembling little girl into his arms. Pushed along with her was the soot-blackened denunciation coupon—of the three black characters "informer" on it, only a ragged half-corner remained.

lines.zh: 阿廖沙……带佳娜走！别管我！我拿过他们的券，我身上脏……我出不去了！这张券你替我留着，等佳娜长大了你告诉她……她姥姥不是坏人……是叫这张破纸逼的！带她走啊——！！
lines.stage: （把佳娜的棉袄领子死死系紧，身子缩在烟火里，喘不上气）
lines.en: Alyosha… take Dyana and go! Leave me! I took their coupon—I'm dirty… I can't get out! Keep this coupon for me, and when Dyana's grown, tell her… her grandmother was no bad woman… it was this scrap of paper that drove her to it! Take her away—!!

lines.zh: 老人转身扑向倒塌的木栏杆，用自己的后背挡住了上方滚落的一截燃烧木梁。
lines.en: The old woman turned and flung herself at the broken wooden railing, taking the full force of a burning beam that rolled down from above on her back.

lines.zh: 佳娜趴在阿列克谢的颈窝里，小脸被烟熏得黝黑，小手紧紧拽着阿列克谢的衣领，眼泪在黑灰里冲出两道白痕。她没有哭喊，只是用极细微的声音在阿列克谢耳边呢喃：
lines.en: Dyana lay against Aleksei's neck, her little face black with smoke, her small hands clutching his collar; tears had carved two white tracks through the soot. She did not cry out. She only whispered into his ear, very softly:

lines.zh: 姥姥说把门焊上风就进不来了，可烟出不去，呛眼睛。叔叔，咱们的钥匙呢？
lines.en: Grandma said if they welded the door shut the wind couldn't get in—but the smoke can't get out, and it stings your eyes. Mister, where are our keys?

lines.zh: 阿列克谢咬紧牙关，单臂将佳娜箍在怀中，另一手挥舞撬棍劈开燃烧的木板冲向底楼。
lines.en: Aleksei set his jaw, locked Dyana to him with one arm, and swung the crowbar with the other, splitting the burning boards as he fought his way down to the ground floor.

lines.zh: 底楼大门前，七级老钳工帕维尔老爹正半跪在地上，手持剧烈喷射蓝白火舌的高压乙炔切割枪，顶着滚滚浓烟疯狂灼烧着焊死横梁的钢骨！
lines.en: At the ground-floor door, Old Pavel, a Grade-7 fitter, was half-kneeling, a high-pressure oxy-acetylene torch spitting blue-white flame in his hands, burning furiously through the steel spine of the welded beam against the rolling smoke!
Hsss—!!

lines.zh: 火星四溅，最后一块焊点在铁锤的猛击下断裂。上百名满脸黑灰的居民终于撞开铁门，像潮水一样跌滚进室外的暴风雪中。灰烬在雪地里迎上去，一口咬住佳娜的棉袄后摆，将女孩安全拖到了避风处。
lines.en: Sparks flew; the last weld gave way under a hammer blow. More than a hundred soot-faced residents finally broke the iron door and poured out into the blizzard like a flood, stumbling and rolling into the snow. Ash bounded into the drifts, caught the back of Dyana's padded coat in its teeth, and dragged the girl safely out of the wind.

lines.zh: 帕维尔抹了一把脸上的焦油，扛起管钳看着阿列克谢。
lines.en: Pavel wiped the tar from his face, shouldered his pipe wrench, and looked at Aleksei.

lines.zh: 车脱轨了。老伊万得手了。布拉风号在鹰嘴崖翻进了雪沟。小子，带上撬棍，我们去翻车！
lines.en: The train's off the rails. Old Ivan pulled the air brake. The Buran went over into a snow gully at Eagle's Crag. Boy, take your crowbar—we're going after the wreck!

5-1.title_en: The Welded-Shut Door and the Child Entrusted in the Flames

5-2.title: 脱轨的铁壳号与 004 原罪铭牌

lines.zh: 鹰嘴崖三十米深的倒木雪谷。
lines.en: A thirty-meter-deep ravine of snow and fallen timber at Eagle's Crag.

lines.zh: 装甲列车“布拉风号”像一条被开膛破肚的钢铁巨蟒横卧在谷底。黑烟从破碎的车窗中翻滚而出，沉重的铸铁转向架断成数截，高压气刹管道发出嘶嘶的漏气绝鸣。
lines.en: The armoured train Buran lay at the bottom like a steel python slit open from belly to tail. Black smoke billowed from its shattered windows; the heavy cast-iron bogies were broken into pieces, and the high-pressure air-brake lines hissed in a final, dying shriek.

lines.zh: 阿列克谢滑下雪坡，手持撬棍踩着齐膝深的积雪走向侧翻的第三节闷罐车厢。
lines.en: Aleksei slid down the snowbank and waded through knee-deep drifts toward the overturned third boxcar, crowbar in hand.

lines.zh: 车厢铁门被撞得严重扭曲变形。阿列克谢把撬棍插进铁门缝隙，青筋暴起，借着全身的重量向下一压！
lines.en: The car's iron door was badly buckled. Aleksei jammed the crowbar into the gap, veins standing out on his hands, and threw his whole weight against it.

lines.zh: 嘎吱——砰！
lines.en: Krrrk—bang!

lines.zh: 生锈的门闩崩飞出去。
lines.en: The rusted bolt sheared off and flew away.

lines.zh: 手电筒光柱扫进车门的瞬间，光线扫过了门框上方——一块被风雪磨得发亮的黄铜铭牌在手电光下骤然刺痛了他的眼睛。
lines.en: The moment the flashlight beam swept inside, it caught the top of the doorframe—a brass nameplate, polished bright by wind and snow, stabbed at his eyes.

lines.zh:
透明工业清漆底下，压着一张发脆的复写纸调拨单，上面是他再熟悉不过的签名：
【车皮调拨单第 004 号 · 转运单位：内务部疫区人员转运计划 · 调拨签发：货运中心三级调度员 阿·莫罗佐夫】
lines.en:
Under a coat of clear industrial varnish lay a brittle carbon-copy dispatch slip, and on it a signature he knew better than his own:
[Dispatch Slip No. 004 · Transfer authority: MVD epidemic-zone personnel transfer plan · Issued by: Third-Grade Dispatcher, Freight Centre, A. Morozov]

lines.zh:
第零幕那个温暖的午后在脑海里疯狂闪回。
“签了它，本周指标算超额……你妈那一箱药明早送进你们楼……”
lines.en:
The warm afternoon of Act Zero flashed back in fragments.
"Sign it, and this week's quota is over target… your mother's crate of medicine goes up to your building first thing tomorrow…"

lines.zh: 阿列克谢手里的撬棍当啷一声落在了雪里。
lines.en: The crowbar clattered out of Aleksei's hand into the snow.

lines.zh: 原来没有别的刽子手。从十天前在调度室里为了母亲低头签字的那一刻起，亲手把妹妹送上这趟死车、亲手给这扇门钉上铁锁的人，就是他自己。
lines.en: There had been no other executioner. From the moment he had bowed his head and signed in the dispatch office ten days ago for his mother's sake, the man who had sent his sister aboard that death train with his own hands and nailed the lock onto that door had been Aleksei himself.

lines.zh: 灰烬走上前，用湿漉漉的鼻头顶了顶阿列克谢无力下垂的手指。
lines.en: Ash stepped forward and nudged his limp, hanging fingers with a wet nose.

lines.zh: 三秒钟的死寂。阿列克谢弯下腰，捡起沾满雪渣的撬棍，狠狠将撬尖砸进铭牌的边缘，伴随着清脆的断裂声，四枚铜铆钉被硬生生撬起。他把那面冰凉锋利的铭牌塞进了胸口内袋，贴着妹妹的那张一寸黑白登记照。
lines.en: Three seconds of dead silence. Aleksei bent, picked up the snow-crusted crowbar, and drove its point savagely into the edge of the nameplate. With a clean crack, four brass rivets were pried loose. He shoved the cold, sharp-edged plate into his inside breast pocket, against the one-inch black-and-white registration photo of his sister.

lines.zh: 手电光终于照亮了车厢内部。
lines.en: At last the flashlight lit the inside of the car.

lines.zh: 没有血肉模糊的怪物，没有丧失理智的丧尸。
lines.en: No mangled monsters. No raving dead.

lines.zh: 车厢里挤坐着一百多个人。他们的棉袄破烂不堪，脸上布满冻疮。但他们手背上的灰鳞全部蜕落干净，露出了正常人的皮肤。他们三三两两依偎在一起取暖，母亲在给孩子擦眼泪，年轻的工人用铝饭盒接着车顶化开的雪水。
lines.en: More than a hundred people sat packed inside. Their padded coats were in rags, their faces covered in frostbite sores—but the Grey Scale on the backs of their hands had all sloughed off, leaving ordinary skin. They huddled together in twos and threes for warmth; a mother wiped her child's tears, and a young worker caught the meltwater dripping from the roof in an aluminium mess tin.

lines.zh: 他们全是从高烧中挺过来的、活生生的人。
lines.en: Every one of them was a living person who had come through the high fever.

lines.zh: 在车厢最里侧靠通风缝的一角，一个瘦得脱相的年轻女孩艰难地抬起了头。她身上裹着一件满是机油污渍的男式厚坎肩，左手腕上还留着最后一小片正在脱落的干燥鳞屑。
lines.en: In the far corner, against the ventilation slit, a gaunt young girl struggled to raise her head. She was wrapped in a man's heavy padded vest stained with machine oil, and the last small patch of dry, peeling scale still clung to her left wrist.

lines.zh: 女孩看着门口那个戴着胶布缠腿眼镜、浑身挂满冰霜的男人，苍白的嘴唇颤抖着，发出了一声轻微却无比清晰的呼唤：
lines.en: She looked at the man in the doorway—his glasses taped at the temple, frost hanging all over him—and her pale lips trembled as she let out a small, unmistakable cry:
…Alyosha?… Brother!!

lines.zh: 眼泪瞬间从女孩凹陷的眼眶中决堤而出。她不顾一切地向车门爬过来，在雪地里伸出那双满是冻疮和划痕的手：
lines.en: Tears broke out of her hollowed eyes in an instant. Reckless, she crawled toward the door, reaching out through the snow with hands covered in chilblains and scratches:

lines.zh: 哥！我的烧退了……我不是怪物！哥，带我回家……
lines.en: Brother! My fever broke… I'm not a monster! Brother, take me home…

lines.zh: 车厢外的雪崖高坡上，两道冰冷刺眼的探照灯骤然打下！
lines.en: On the high snowbank outside the car, two icy searchlights slammed down!

lines.zh: 身穿重型黑色防化服的清杀队督察专员站在履带装甲车顶端，手持扩音器，声音如同齿轮般不带任何人类感情：
lines.en: An OSK commissioner in a heavy black chemical-protection suit stood atop a tracked armoured carrier, megaphone in hand, his voice as flat and joyless as turning gears:

lines.zh: 各肃清小队就位！核对第三节车厢档案号 0401 至 0576！全车 176 人属于‘已签发注销状态’。不管里头能不能说话，名单必须闭合！准备投掷铝热剂燃烧弹，就地清除！
lines.en: All purge squads, take your positions! Check the third boxcar's file numbers 0401 through 0576! All 176 aboard are marked "issued de-registration status." Whether they can still speak in there or not, the list must be closed! Prepare the thermite incendiary—purge on the spot!

lines.zh: 崖顶的高架机枪发出拉栓的脆响。
lines.en: On the cliff above, the heavy machine gun's bolt clicked back.

- **👉 D1【砸锁抢人，杀上 302 高地广播塔】**
  阿列克谢一把将拉娜拉进怀里，背在背上。切尔诺夫中士在崖顶猛地扯下内务部白袖标，莫辛纳甘步枪一枪击碎了主探照灯！一百多名康复者举起饭盒和撬棍发出震天呐喊。突围部队直扑全城最高的 302 广播高地！（进入第六幕，通往隐藏真结局或结局 B）。

- **👉 D2【顺从挂锁，闭合账面】**
  在极度的崩溃与恐惧下，阿列克谢松开了妹妹的手。他听从督察专员的命令退后三步，亲手替车厢拉上了粗铁栓。铝热剂燃烧弹在车厢内炸开，火光将雪谷照得通红。（直接进入**结局 A · 击毙仁慈**）。

- **👉 D3【独自逃离，隐入极夜】**

## 第六幕：天光、血肉闸刀与全城破门（广播死守与五结局收束）

- **关卡代号**：L10（仅 D1 触发）
- **场景**：302 高地苏联广播发射塔顶层机房 → 诺沃斯克-17 第一安全区主关卡
- **时间**：午夜 23:50 – 极夜破晓
- **登场人物**：阿列克谢、拉娜、帕维尔老爹、安娜、古丽娅、梁诺夫、切尔诺夫中士、全城铁路工人与居民
- **核心机制**：180 秒发射台阵地防守、帕维尔血肉压闸 QTE、短句喘息式实名点名、五结局终末演出

6-1.title: 帕维尔老爹的血肉闸刀

lines.zh: 302 高地广播发射塔。
lines.en: The Hill 302 radio transmission tower.

lines.zh: 狂暴的暴风雪拍打着机房巨大的弧形防爆玻璃。外围防线上，装甲运兵车的柴油发动机在低沉咆哮，清杀队的加重穿甲弹将配电室的水泥砖打得碎屑横飞。
lines.en: A raging blizzard hammered at the great curved blast-proof glass of the transmitter room. Along the outer defence line, armoured personnel carriers growled their diesel low; OSK heavy armour-piercing rounds chewed the distribution room's brickwork into flying chips.

lines.zh: 轰！
lines.en: Boom!

lines.zh: 一发穿甲弹打穿了外墙，瞬间击碎了主配电盘的绝缘高压瓷瓶！粗大的铜闸刀在高压短路中断开，跳出一团爆燃的蓝白火球！机房中央那两排两米高的巨型电子管发射机红灯骤灭，全城广播网络陷入死寂！
lines.en: An armour-piercing round punched through the outer wall and shattered the high-voltage porcelain insulators of the main switchboard! The heavy copper knife switch tore open on short circuit, bursting into a ball of blue-white flame. The red lamps of the two rows of towering two-meter vacuum-tube transmitters in the middle of the room died at once, and the citywide broadcast network fell silent.

lines.zh: 突击队的防寒靴声已经逼近楼梯拐角。
lines.en: The assault team's winter boots were already closing on the stairwell corner.

lines.zh: 七级老钳工帕维尔老爹抹了一把嘴角的血沫子，一把抄起他用了四十年的重型绝缘包胶管钳，猛地卡进了铜闸刀断开的触点之间！
lines.en: Old Pavel, the Grade-7 fitter, wiped the blood foam from the corner of his mouth, seized the heavy insulated pipe wrench he had used for forty years, and jammed it between the open contacts of the copper switch.

lines.zh: 阿廖沙！去台子前面！把麦克风拧开！
lines.stage: （扭过头，用充血的眼睛盯着阿列克谢和浑身发抖的拉娜）
lines.en: Alyosha! Get to the console! Switch the microphone on!

lines.zh: 老人吸了一口气，将全身一百六十斤的体重狠狠压在管钳手柄上，用自己的胸膛和肩膀压住铜闸，硬生生将断开的万伏电闸压回了通电触槽！
lines.en: The old man drew a breath and threw all his weight—160 jin—onto the handle, pressing his chest and shoulders against the copper blade, forcing the ten-thousand-volt switch back into its live slot.

lines.zh: 呲啦——轰！！
lines.en: Kzzz—boom!!

lines.zh: 万伏高压电弧顺着管钳炸开，狂暴的电流在老人的双臂和胸口爆出焦糊的青烟。帕维尔的双脚死死蹬在水泥机座的边缘，脖颈上的青筋暴起如铁丝，浑身剧烈颤抖，像一尊铸死在配电盘前的乌拉尔钢铁雕塑！
lines.en: The ten-thousand-volt arc exploded along the wrench; furious current burst from the old man's arms and chest in scorched blue smoke. His feet braced hard against the edge of the concrete plinth, the veins on his neck standing out like wire, his whole body shaking—an Ural statue of steel cast in place before the switchboard.

lines.zh: 电子管发射机在一秒钟内重新亮起刺眼的血红光芒！
lines.en: Within a second the vacuum-tube transmitters blazed back to eye-searing crimson!

lines.zh: 全城二十四个工人居住区、三千个锈迹斑斑的铁皮高音喇叭，在午夜的风雪中被同时接通！
lines.en: Across the city, twenty-four workers' districts and three thousand rusted tin loudspeakers were live at once in the midnight blizzard!
