6-2.title: 碎裂的自白与实名点名

lines.zh: 拉娜与安娜冲到老式碳精麦克风前。两个刚刚死里逃生的女孩握着被汗水湿透的麦克风，把带着哭腔的证言直接吼进了全市所有人的耳朵里：
lines.en: Lana and Anna rushed to the old carbon microphone. Two girls snatched back from death gripped the sweat-soaked mike and shouted their testimony, voices breaking with sobs, into the ears of everyone in the city:

lines.zh: 诺沃斯克的人听着！我是拉娜·莫罗佐娃！档案号 0420！
lines.en: People of Novorsk-17, listen! This is Lana Morozova! File 0420!

lines.zh: 我是安娜！档案号 0419！我们的高烧退了！灰鳞掉了！人不会变成怪物！第三节车厢里拉去矿坑的一百七十六个人全活着！！
lines.en: This is Anna! File 0419! Our fevers broke! The Grey Scale fell off! People don't turn into monsters! All 176 of us taken from the third boxcar to the mine are alive!!

lines.zh: 突击队的撞门木撞裂了机房木门。阿列克谢跃出掩体，撬棍砸偏了冲锋枪的枪口，左肩中弹。他单膝跪在发射台前，一把扯过麦克风。
lines.en: The assault team's battering ram cracked the transmitter room's wooden door. Aleksei leapt from cover, knocked the submachine gun's muzzle aside with his crowbar, and took a bullet in the left shoulder. He dropped to one knee before the console and dragged the microphone to him.

lines.zh: 没有冗长的讲稿，没有四字成语的排比。他嘴里呛着血沫，每呼吸一口，肺部都发出破风箱般的嘶鸣：
lines.en: No long speech, no set phrases in parallel rows. Blood foamed in his mouth; every breath came out of his lungs with the shriek of a broken bellows:

lines.zh: ……我是货运站调度员阿列克谢。我怀里揣着一块铜铭牌……第 004 号车皮调拨单……十天前，为了给我妈换一箱透析液，我亲手签的字……
lines.stage: （喘着粗气，声音嘶哑而坚决）
lines.en: …I'm Aleksei, a dispatcher at the freight station. I've got a brass nameplate here in my coat… Dispatch Slip No. 004… Ten days ago I signed it myself, to buy Mama Katya a crate of dialysis fluid…

lines.zh: 阿列克谢从怀里掏出那块带血的黄铜铭牌，狠狠贴在麦克风的铁丝网上。金属碰撞发出刺耳的啸叫：
lines.en: Aleksei pulled the bloodstained brass plate from his coat and slammed it against the microphone's wire mesh. Metal shrieked against metal:

lines.zh: 就是这块单子，把我妹妹锁进了车厢……他们从来不要你们服从，他们要你们跟他们一样，手也沾上血，变成共犯！可我现在把底账念给你们听——
lines.en: This slip is what locked my sister in that boxcar… They never wanted your obedience. They wanted you to be like them—blood on your hands too, accomplices! But now I'm reading you the real ledger—

lines.zh: 阿列克谢翻开那本被血染透的《工作日志》背面，用沾满血迹的手指指着上面每一个亲手记下的名字：
lines.en: Aleksei turned to the blood-soaked back pages of his work logbook and pointed with a bloodied finger at every name he had written there with his own hand:

lines.zh:
南库 3 号柱，谢尔盖、玛丽亚！活人！
白桦林 402 室，莉莉娅！活人！
东街食堂，瓦西里！死前喊的是渴！不是怪物，是活人！
601 室，柳德米拉！她为了外孙女告密，换来的券连门都出不去！
lines.en:
Pillar No. 3, South Depot — Sergei and Maria! Alive!
Room 402, Birch Grove — Liliya! Alive!
East Street Canteen — Vasily! What he cried out as he died was "Thirsty!" Not a monster. A living man!
Room 601 — Lyudmila! She informed on a neighbour for her granddaughter, and the coupon she got in return wouldn't even get her out the door!

lines.zh: 阿列克谢一把将装满灰黑孢子粉末的岩芯举在镜头般的电台信号灯下：
lines.stage: （若取得【矿坑核心证物 E1】）
lines.en: Aleksei thrust a core sample packed with grey-black spore dust under the radio's signal lamp, bright as a camera lens:

lines.zh: 还有——灰鳞病不是天降的神罚！是他们为了赶工期，用温压炸药炸穿了 3 号矿坑的万年冻土，放出了山里的远古菌丝！他们要把活人和矿坑一起炸塌销账！这是岩芯！这是工程图！病是他们炸出来的，账是拿你们的命平的！！
lines.en: And one more thing—Grey Scale fever is no punishment from heaven! They blasted through the ten-thousand-year permafrost of Mine Shaft No. 3 with thermobaric charges to meet their deadlines, and let the ancient mycelium out of the mountain! They meant to blow the living and the pit together and write the whole thing off! This is the core sample! This is the engineering plan! The sickness is something they blasted out of the ground—and they balanced their books with your lives!!

lines.zh: 高音喇叭的声浪回荡在整座西伯利亚冰城的夜空下。
lines.en: The wave of sound from the loudspeakers rolled back and forth beneath the night sky of the whole Siberian ice city.

lines.zh: 赫鲁晓夫楼的走廊里，一个个原本反锁的防盗门被从内侧拉开。人们走出家门，手里握着修铁轨的撬棍、大锤、砍柴的斧头和铁皮扳手。
lines.en: In the corridors of the Khrushchyovka blocks, door after locked door was pulled open from the inside. People came out of their apartments carrying railway crowbars, sledgehammers, firewood axes, and tin wrenches.

lines.zh: 年轻的清杀哨兵科利亚端着步枪站在高墙上，看着潮水般涌上铁轨的工人，手里的枪慢慢垂了下去。
lines.en: On the high wall, a young OSK sentry, Kolya, held his rifle on the workers pouring onto the tracks like a tide—and slowly let the barrel drop.

lines.zh: 广播结束后，同伴会根据阿列克谢一路上的选择回应他。若他多次杀戮、出卖同伴或掠夺无抵抗者，安娜、古丽娅、伊万和帕维尔仍承认他救出了车厢里的人，却不再把后背交给他；若他持续救助他人且没有留下杀戮划痕，他们会主动留下来与他一起守住发射台。角色观感由已经发生的行动改变，不用一段突兀的台词把所有人改成同一种反应。
lines.en: When the broadcast ends, companions respond to Aleksei according to the choices he has made along the way. If he has killed often, betrayed comrades, or preyed on those who could not resist, Anna, Gulya, Ivan, and Pavel will still grant that he saved the people in the boxcar—but they will no longer turn their backs to him. If he has kept helping others and left no tally strokes behind, they will stay of their own accord and hold the transmitter with him. How characters feel changes with what has already happened; no single line of dialogue should force everyone into the same reaction.

lines.zh: 若扎哈尔仍在队伍中，且阿列克谢达到灭绝人性的路线判定（卌划痕不少于 2，或良知不高于 25），扎哈尔会趁广播塔遭到围攻时把阿列克谢的位置报给清杀队，换取冬季配额。他此前在货场已经说过这笔账。举报引来下一轮搜捕，扎哈尔离队；其他同伴会把这次背叛记在阿列克谢的选择上。
lines.en: If Zakhar is still with the group, and Aleksei meets the judgment for the dehumanized path—no fewer than 2 tally strokes (卌), or a conscience score no higher than 25—Zakhar will sell Aleksei's position to the OSK while the tower is under siege, in exchange for a winter quota. He spoke of that account back at the freight yard already. The denunciation brings the next round of searches; Zakhar leaves the group, and the other companions will lay this betrayal on Aleksei's choices.

6-2.title_en: The Broken Confession and the Roll Call of Names
